H7519 רָצָא (râtsâʼ, raw-tsaw'): to run; also to delight in. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: accept, run.

H7520 רָצַד (râtsad, raw-tsad'): probably to look askant, i.e. (figuratively) be jealous. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: leap.

H7521 רָצָה (râtsâh, raw-tsaw'): to be pleased with; specifically, to satisfy adebt. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (be) accept(-able), accomplish, set affection, approve, consent with, delight (self), enjoy, (be, have a) favour(-able), like, observe, pardon, (be, have, take) please(-ure), reconcile self.

H7522 רָצוֹן (râtsôwn, raw-tsone'): delight (especially as shown). Origin: or רָצֹן; from H7521 (רָצָה); KJV: (be) acceptable(-ance, -ed), delight, desire, favour, (good) pleasure, (own, self, voluntary) will, as...(what) would.

H7523 רָצַח (râtsach, raw-tsakh'): properly, to dash in pieces, i.e. kill (a human being), especially to murder. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: put to death, kill, (man-) slay(-er), murder(-er).

H7524 רֶצַח (retsach, reh-tsakh): a crushing; specifically, a murder-cry. Origin: from H7523 (רָצַח); KJV: slaughter, sword.

H7525 רִצְיָא (Ritsyâʼ, rits-yaw'): Ritsjah, an Israelite. Origin: from H7521 (רָצָה); delight; KJV: Rezia.

H7526 רְצִין (Rᵉtsîyn, rets-een'): Retsin, the name of a Syrian and of an Israelite. Origin: probably for H7522 (רָצוֹן); KJV: Rezin.

H7527 רָצַע (râtsaʻ, raw-tsah'): to pierce. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: bore.

H7528 רָצַף (râtsaph, raw-tsaf'): to tessellate, i.e. embroider (as if with bright stones). Origin: a denominative from H7529 (רֶצֶף); KJV: pave.

H7529 רֶצֶף (retseph, reh'-tsef): a red-hot stone (for baking). Origin: for H7565 (רֶשֶׁף); KJV: coal.

H7530 רֶצֶף (Retseph, reh'-tsef): Retseph, a place in Assyrian. Origin: the same as H7529 (רֶצֶף); KJV: Rezeph.

H7531 רִצְפָּה (ritspâh, rits-paw'): a hot stone; also a tessellated pavement. Origin: feminine of H7529 (רֶצֶף); KJV: live coal, pavement.

H7532 רִצְפָּה (Ritspâh, rits-paw'): Ritspah, an Israelitess. Origin: the same as H7531 (רִצְפָּה); KJV: Rizpah.

H7533 רָצַץ (râtsats, raw-tsats'): to crack in pieces, literally or figuratively. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: break, bruise, crush, discourage, oppress, struggle together.

H7534 רַק (raq, rak): emaciated (as if flattened out). Origin: from H7556 (רָקַק) in its original sense; KJV: lean(-fleshed), thin.

H7535 רַק (raq, rak): properly, leanness, i.e. (figuratively) limitation; only adverbial, merely, or conjunctional, although. Origin: the same as H7534 (רַק) as a noun; KJV: but, even, except, howbeit howsoever, at the least, nevertheless, nothing but, notwithstanding, only, save, so (that), surely, yet (so), in any wise.

H7536 רֹק (rôq, roke): spittle. Origin: from H7556 (רָקַק); KJV: spit(-ting, -tle).

H7537 רָקַב (râqab, raw-kab'): to decay (as by worm-eating). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: rot.

H7538 רָקָב (râqâb, raw-kawb'): decay (by caries). Origin: from H7537 (רָקַב); KJV: rottenness (thing).

H7539 רִקָּבוֹן (riqqâbôwn, rik-kaw-bone'): decay (by caries). Origin: from H7538 (רָקָב); KJV: rotten.

H7540 רָקַד (râqad, raw-kad'): properly, to stamp, i.e. to spring about (wildly or for joy). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: dance, jump, leap, skip.

title: Strong's Hebrew Dictionary, H7541 to H7667
source: James Strong, A Concise Dictionary of the Words in the Hebrew Bible (1894), public domain; JSON edition by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA). Each entry: Strong number, Hebrew word, Latin reading, meaning, origin, how the KJV renders it.
body:
H7541 רַקָּה (raqqâh, rak-kaw'): properly, thinness, i.e. the side of the head. Origin: feminine of H7534 (רַק); KJV: temple.

H7542 רַקּוֹן (Raqqôwn, rak-kone'): Rakkon, a place in Palestine. Origin: from H7534 (רַק); thinness; KJV: Rakkon.

H7543 רָקַח (râqach, raw-kakh'): to perfume. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: apothecary, compound, make (ointment), prepare, spice.

H7544 רֶקַח (reqach, reh'-kakh): properly, perfumery, i.e. (by implication) spicery (for flavor). Origin: from H7543 (רָקַח); KJV: spiced.

H7545 רֹקַח (rôqach, ro'-kakh): an aromatic. Origin: from H7542 (רַקּוֹן); KJV: confection, ointment.

H7546 רַקָּח (raqqâch, rak-kawkh'): a male perfumer. Origin: from H7543 (רָקַח); KJV: apothecary.

H7547 רַקֻּחַ (raqquach, rak-koo'-akh): a scented substance. Origin: from H7543 (רָקַח); KJV: perfume.

H7548 רַקָּחָה (raqqâchâh, rak-kaw-khaw'): a female perfumer. Origin: feminine of H7547 (רַקֻּחַ); KJV: confectioner.

H7549 רָקִיעַ (râqîyaʻ, raw-kee'-ah): properly, an expanse, i.e. the firmament or (apparently) visible arch of the sky. Origin: from H7554 (רָקַע); KJV: firmament.

H7550 רָקִיק (râqîyq, raw-keek'): a thin cake. Origin: from, H7556 (רָקַק) in its original sense; KJV: cake, wafer.

H7551 רָקַם (râqam, raw-kam'): to variegate color, i.e. embroider; by implication, to fabricate. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: embroiderer, needlework, curiously work.

H7552 רֶקֶם (Reqem, reh'-kem): Rekem, the name of a place in Palestine, also of a Midianite and an Israelite. Origin: from H7551 (רָקַם); versi-color; KJV: Rekem.

H7553 רִקְמָה (riqmâh, rik-maw'): variegation of color; specifically, embroidery. Origin: from H7551 (רָקַם); KJV: broidered (work), divers colours, (raiment of) needlework (on both sides).

H7554 רָקַע (râqaʻ, raw-kah'): to pound the earth (as a sign of passion); by analogy to expand (by hammering); by implication, to overlay (with thin sheets of metal). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: beat, make broad, spread abroad (forth, over, out, into plates), stamp, stretch.

H7555 רִקֻּעַ (riqquaʻ, rik-koo'-ah): beaten out, i.e. a (metallic) plate. Origin: from H7554 (רָקַע); KJV: broad.

H7556 רָקַק (râqaq, raw-kak'): to spit. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: spit.

H7557 רַקַּת (Raqqath, rak-kath'): Rakkath, a place in Palestine. Origin: from H7556 (רָקַק) in its original sense of diffusing; a beach (as expanded shingle); KJV: Rakkath.

H7558 רִשְׁיוֹן (rishyôwn, rish-yone'): a permit. Origin: from an unused root meaning to have leave; KJV: grant.

H7559 רָשַׁם (râsham, raw-sham'): to record. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: note.

H7560 רְשַׁם (rᵉsham, resh-am'): {to record}. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7559 (רָשַׁם) KJV: sign, write.

H7561 רָשַׁע (râshaʻ, raw-shah'): to be (causatively, do or declare) wrong; by implication, to disturb, violate. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: condemn, make trouble, vex, be (commit, deal, depart, do) wicked(-ly, -ness).

H7562 רֶשַׁע (reshaʻ, reh'-shah): a wrong (especially moral). Origin: from H7561 (רָשַׁע); KJV: iniquity, wicked(-ness).

H7563 רָשָׁע (râshâʻ, raw-shaw'): morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person. Origin: from H7561 (רָשַׁע); KJV: [phrase] condemned, guilty, ungodly, wicked (man), that did wrong.

H7564 רִשְׁעָה (rishʻâh, rish-aw'): wrong (especially moral). Origin: feminine of H7562 (רֶשַׁע); KJV: fault, wickedly(-ness).

H7565 רֶשֶׁף (resheph, reh'-shef): a live coal; by analogy lightning; figuratively, an arrow, (as flashing through the air); specifically, fever. Origin: from H8313 (שָׂרַף); KJV: arrow, (burning) coal, burning heat, [phrase] spark, hot thunderbolt.

H7566 רֶשֶׁף (Resheph, reh'-shef): Resheph, an Israelite. Origin: the same as H7565 (רֶשֶׁף); KJV: Resheph.

H7567 רָשַׁשׁ (râshash, raw-shash'): to demolish. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: impoverish.

H7568 רֶשֶׁת (resheth, reh'-sheth): a net (as catching animals). Origin: from H3423 (יָרַשׁ); KJV: net(-work).

H7569 רַתּוֹק (rattôwq, rat-toke'): a chain. Origin: from H7576 (רָתַק); KJV: chain.

H7570 רָתַח (râthach, raw-thakh'): to boil. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: boil.

H7571 רֶתַח (rethach, reh'-thakh): a boiling. Origin: from H7570 (רָתַח); KJV: [idiom] (boil) well.

H7572 רַתִּיקָה (rattîyqâh, rat-tee-kaw'): a chain. Origin: from H7576 (רָתַק); KJV: chain.

H7573 רָתַם (râtham, raw-tham'): to yoke up (to the pole of a vehicle). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: bind.

H7574 רֶתֶם (rethem, reh'-them): the Spanish broom (from its pole-like stems). Origin: or רֹתֶם; from H7573 (רָתַם); KJV: juniper (tree).

H7575 רִתְמָה (Rithmâh, rith-maw'): Rithmah, a place in the Desert. Origin: feminine of H7574 (רֶתֶם); KJV: Rithmah.

H7576 רָתַק (râthaq, raw-thak'): to fasten. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: bind.

H7577 רְתֻקָה (rᵉthuqâh, reth-oo-kaw'): something fastened, i.e. a chain. Origin: feminine passive participle of H7576 (רָתַק); KJV: chain.

H7578 רְתֵת (rᵉthêth, reth-ayth'): terror. Origin: for H7374 (רֶטֶט); KJV: trembling. �

H7579 שָׁאַב (shâʼab, sahw-ab'): to bale up water. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (woman to) draw(-er, water).

H7580 שָׁאַג (shâʼag, shaw-ag'): to rumble or moan. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: [idiom] mightily, roar.

H7581 שְׁאָגָה (shᵉʼâgâh, sheh-aw-gaw'): a rumbling or moan. Origin: from H7580 (שָׁאַג); KJV: roaring.

H7582 שָׁאָה (shâʼâh, shaw-aw'): to rush; by implication, to desolate. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: be desolate, (make a) rush(-ing), (lay) waste.

H7583 שָׁאָה (shâʼâh, shaw-aw'): to stun, i.e. (intransitively) be astonished. Origin: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of whirling to giddiness); KJV: wonder.

H7584 שַׁאֲוָה (shaʼăvâh, shah-av-aw'): a tempest (as rushing). Origin: from H7582 (שָׁאָה); KJV: desolation.

H7585 שְׁאוֹל (shᵉʼôwl, sheh-ole'): Hades or the world of the dead (as if a subterranean retreat), including its accessories and inmates. Origin: or שְׁאֹל; from H7592 (שָׁאַל); KJV: grave, hell, pit.

H7586 שָׁאוּל (Shâʼûwl, shaw-ool'): Shaul, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites. Origin: passive participle of H7592 (שָׁאַל); asked; KJV: Saul, Shaul.

H7587 שָׁאוּלִי (Shâʼûwlîy, shaw-oo-lee'): a Shaulite or descendant of Shaul. Origin: patronymic from H7856 (שִׂטְנָה); KJV: Shaulites.

H7588 שָׁאוֹן (shâʼôwn, shaw-one'): uproar (as of rushing); by implication, destruction. Origin: from H7582 (שָׁאָה); KJV: [idiom] horrible, noise, pomp, rushing, tumult ([idiom] -uous).

H7589 שְׁאָט (shᵉʼâṭ, sheh-awt'): contempt. Origin: from an unused root meaning to push aside; KJV: despite(-ful).

H7590 שָׁאט (shâʼṭ, shawt): one contemning. Origin: for active part of H7750 (שׂוּט) (compare H7589 (שְׁאָט)); KJV: that (which) despise(-d).

H7591 שְׁאִיָּה (shᵉʼîyâh, sheh-ee-yaw'): desolation. Origin: from H7582 (שָׁאָה); KJV: destruction.

H7592 שָׁאַל (shâʼal, shaw-al'): to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand. Origin: or שָׁאֵל; a primitive root; KJV: ask (counsel, on), beg, borrow, lay to charge, consult, demand, desire, [idiom] earnestly, enquire, [phrase] greet, obtain leave, lend, pray, request, require, [phrase] salute, [idiom] straitly, [idiom] surely, wish.

H7593 שְׁאֵל (shᵉʼêl, sheh-ale'): {to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand}. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7592 (שָׁאַל) KJV: ask, demand, require.

H7594 שְׁאָל (Shᵉʼâl, sheh-awl'): Sheal, an Israelite. Origin: from H7592 (שָׁאַל); request; KJV: Sheal.

H7595 שְׁאֵלָא (shᵉʼêlâʼ, sheh-ay-law'): properly, a question (at law), i.e. judicial decision or mandate. Origin: (Aramaic) from H7593 (שְׁאֵל); KJV: demand.

H7596 שְׁאֵלָה (shᵉʼêlâh, sheh-ay-law'): a petition; by implication, a loan. Origin: or שֵׁלָה; (1 Samuel 1:17), from H7592 (שָׁאַל); KJV: loan, petition, request.

H7597 שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל (Shᵉʼaltîyʼêl, sheh-al-tee-ale'): Shealtiel, an Israelite. Origin: or שַׁלְתִּיאֵל; from H7592 (שָׁאַל) and H410 (אֵל); I have asked God; KJV: Shalthiel, Shealtiel.

H7598 שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל (Shᵉʼaltîyʼêl, sheh-al-tee-ale'): {Shealtiel, an Israelite}. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7597 (שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל) KJV: Shealtiel.

H7599 שָׁאַן (shâʼan, shaw-an'): to loll, i.e. be peaceful. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: be at ease, be quiet, rest. See also H1052 (בֵּית שְׁאָן).

H7600 שַׁאֲנָן (shaʼănân, shah-an-awn'): secure; in a bad sense, haughty. Origin: from H7599 (שָׁאַן); KJV: that is at ease, quiet, tumult. Compare H7946 (שַׁלְאֲנָן).

H7601 שָׁאַס (shâʼaç, shaw-as'): to plunder. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: spoil.

H7602 שָׁאַף (shâʼaph, shaw-af'): to inhale eagerly; figuratively, to cover; by implication, to be angry; also to hasten. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: desire (earnestly), devour, haste, pant, snuff up, swallow up.

H7603 שְׂאֹר (sᵉʼôr, seh-ore'): barm or yeast-cake (as swelling by fermentation). Origin: from H7604 (שָׁאַר); KJV: leaven.

H7604 שָׁאַר (shâʼar, shaw-ar'): properly, to swell up, i.e. be (causatively, make) redundant. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: leave, (be) left, let, remain, remnant, reserve, the rest.

H7605 שְׁאָר (shᵉʼâr, sheh-awr'): a remainder. Origin: from H7604 (שָׁאַר); KJV: [idiom] other, remnant, residue, rest.

H7606 שְׁאָר (shᵉʼâr, sheh-awr'): {a remainder}. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7605 (שְׁאָר) KJV: [idiom] whatsoever more, residue, rest.

H7607 שְׁאֵר (shᵉʼêr, sheh-ayr'): flesh (as swelling out), as living or forfood; generally food of any kind; figuratively, kindred by blood. Origin: from H7604 (שָׁאַר); KJV: body, flesh, food, (near) kin(-sman, -swoman), near (nigh) (of kin).

H7608 שַׁאֲרָה (shaʼărâh, shah-ar-aw'): female kindred by blood. Origin: feminine of H7607 (שְׁאֵר); KJV: near kinswomen.

H7609 שֶׁאֱרָה (Sheʼĕrâh, sheh-er-aw'): Sheerah, an Israelitess. Origin: the same as H7608 (שַׁאֲרָה); KJV: Sherah.

H7610 שְׁאָר יָשׁוּב (Shᵉʼâr Yâshûwb, sheh-awr'yaw-shoob'): Shear-Jashub, the symbolic name of one of Isaiah's sons. Origin: from H7605 (שְׁאָר) and H7725 (שׁוּב); a remnant will return; KJV: Shear-jashub.

H7611 שְׁאֵרִית (shᵉʼêrîyth, sheh-ay-reeth'): a remainder or residual (surviving, final) portion. Origin: from H7604 (שָׁאַר); KJV: that had escaped, be left, posterity, remain(-der), remnant, residue, rest.

H7612 שֵׁאת (shêʼth, shayth): devastation. Origin: from H7582 (שָׁאָה); KJV: desolation.

H7613 שְׂאֵת (sᵉʼêth, seh-ayth'): an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively, elation or cheerfulness; exaltation in rank or character. Origin: from H5375 (נָשָׂא); KJV: be accepted, dignity, excellency, highness, raise up self, rising.

H7614 שְׁבָא (Shᵉbâʼ, sheb-aw'): Sheba, the name of three early progenitors of tribes and of an Ethiopian district. Origin: of foreign origin; KJV: Sheba, Sabeans.

H7615 שְׁבָאִי (Shᵉbâʼîy, sheb-aw-ee'): a Shebaite or descendant of Sheba. Origin: patronymic from H7614 (שְׁבָא); KJV: Sabean.

H7616 שָׁבָב (shâbâb, shaw-bawb'): a fragment, i.e. ruin. Origin: from an unused root meaning to break up; KJV: broken in pieces.

H7617 שָׁבָה (shâbâh, shaw-baw'): to transport into captivity. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (bring away, carry, carry away, lead, lead away, take) captive(-s), drive (take) away.

H7618 שְׁבוּ (shᵉbûw, sheb-oo'): a gem (from its sparkle), probably the agate. Origin: from an unused root (probably identical with that of H7617 (שָׁבָה) through the idea of subdivision into flashes or streamers (compare H7632 (שָׁבִיב)) meaning to flame; KJV: agate.

H7619 שְׁבוּאֵל (Shᵉbûwʼêl, sheb-oo-ale'): Shebuel or Shubael, the name of two Israelites. Origin: or שׁוּבָאֵל; from H7617 (שָׁבָה) (abbreviated form) or H7725 (שׁוּב) and H410 (אֵל); captive (or returned) of God; KJV: Shebuel, Shubael.

H7620 שָׁבוּעַ (shâbûwaʻ, shaw-boo'-ah): literally, sevened, i.e. a week (specifically, of years). Origin: or שָׁבֻעַ; also (feminine) שְׁבֻעָה; properly, passive participle of H7650 (שָׁבַע) as a denominative of H7651 (שֶׁבַע); KJV: seven, week.

H7621 שְׁבוּעָה (shᵉbûwʻâh, sheb-oo-aw'): properly, something sworn, i.e. an oath. Origin: feminine passive participle of H7650 (שָׁבַע); KJV: curse, oath, [idiom] sworn.

H7622 שְׁבוּת (shᵉbûwth, sheb-ooth'): exile, concretely, prisoners; figuratively, a former state of prosperity. Origin: or שְׁבִית; from H7617 (שָׁבָה); KJV: captive(-ity).

H7623 שָׁבַח (shâbach, shaw-bakh'): properly, to address in aloud tone, i.e. (specifically) loud; figuratively, to pacify (as if by words). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: commend, glory, keep in, praise, still, triumph.

H7624 שְׁבַח (shᵉbach, sheb-akh'): to adulate, i.e. adore. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7623 (שָׁבַח); KJV: praise.

H7625 שְׁבַט (shᵉbaṭ, sheb-at'): a clan. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7626 (שֵׁבֶט); KJV: tribe.

H7626 שֵׁבֶט (shêbeṭ, shay'-bet): a scion, i.e. (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan. Origin: from an unused root probably meaning to branch off; KJV: [idiom] correction, dart, rod, sceptre, staff, tribe.

H7627 שְׁבָט (Shᵉbâṭ, sheb-awt'): Shebat, a Jewish month. Origin: of foreign origin; KJV: Sebat.

H7628 שְׁבִי (shᵉbîy, sheb-ee'): exiled; captured; as noun, exile (abstractly or concretely and collectively); by extension, booty. Origin: from H7618 (שְׁבוּ); KJV: captive(-ity), prisoners, [idiom] take away, that was taken.

H7629 שֹׁבִי (Shôbîy, sho-bee'): Shobi, an Ammonite. Origin: from H7617 (שָׁבָה); captor; KJV: Shobi.

H7630 שֹׁבַי (Shôbay, sho-bah'-ee): Shobai, an Israelite. Origin: for H7629 (שֹׁבִי); KJV: Shobai.

H7631 שְׂבִיב (sᵉbîyb, seb-eeb'): {flame (as split into tongues)}. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7632 (שָׁבִיב) KJV: flame.

H7632 שָׁבִיב (shâbîyb, shaw-beeb'): flame (as split into tongues). Origin: from the same as H7616 (שָׁבָב); KJV: spark.

H7633 שִׁבְיָה (shibyâh, shib-yaw'): exile (abstractly or concretely and collectively). Origin: feminine of H7628 (שְׁבִי); KJV: captives(-ity).

H7634 שׇׁבְיָה (Shobyâh, shob-yaw'): Shobjah, an Israelite. Origin: feminine of the same as H7629 (שֹׁבִי); captivation; KJV: Shachia (from the margin).

H7635 שָׁבִיל (shâbîyl, shaw-beel'): a track or passage-way (as if flowing along). Origin: from the same as H7640 (שֹׁבֶל); KJV: path.

H7636 שָׁבִיס (shâbîyç, shaw-beece'): a netting for the hair. Origin: from an unused root meaning to interweave; KJV: caul.

H7637 שְׁבִיעִי (shᵉbîyʻîy, sheb-ee-ee'): seventh. Origin: or שְׁבִעִי; ordinal from H7657 (שִׁבְעִים); KJV: seventh (time).

H7638 שָׂבָךְ (sâbâk, saw-bawk'): a netting (ornament to the capital of a column). Origin: from an unused root meaning to intwine; KJV: net.

H7639 שְׂבָכָה (sᵉbâkâh, seb-aw-kaw'): a net-work, i.e. (in hunting) a snare, (in architecture) a ballustrade; also a reticulated ornament to apillar. Origin: feminine of H7638 (שָׂבָךְ); KJV: checker, lattice, network, snare, wreath(-enwork).

H7640 שֹׁבֶל (shôbel, show'-bel): a lady's train (as trailing after her). Origin: from an unused root meaning to flow; KJV: leg.

H7641 שִׁבֹּל (shibbôl, shib-bole): a stream (as flowing); also an ear of grain (as growing out); by analogy, a branch. Origin: or (feminine) שִׁבֹּלֶת; from the same as H7640 (שֹׁבֶל); KJV: branch, channel, ear (of corn), (water-)flood, Shibboleth. Compare H5451 (סִבֹּלֶת).

H7642 שַׁבְלוּל (shablûwl, shab-lool'): a snail (as if floating in its own slime). Origin: from the same as H7640 (שֹׁבֶל); KJV: snail.

H7643 שְׂבָם (Sᵉbâm, seb-awm'): Sebam or Sibmah, a place in Moab. Origin: or (feminine) שִׂבְמָה; probably from H1313 (בָּשָׂם); spice; KJV: Shebam, Shibmah, Sibmah.

H7644 שֶׁבְנָא (Shebnâʼ, sheb-naw'): Shebna or Shebnah, an Israelite. Origin: or שֶׁבְנָה; from an unused root meaning to grow; growth; KJV: Shebna, Shebnah.

H7645 שְׁבַנְיָה (Shᵉbanyâh, sheb-an-yaw'): Shebanjah, the name of three or four Israelites. Origin: or שְׁבַנְיָהוּ; from the same as H7644 (שֶׁבְנָא) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has grown (i.e. prospered); KJV: Shebaniah.

H7646 שָׂבַע (sâbaʻ, saw-bah'): to sate, i.e. fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively). Origin: or שָׂבֵעַ; a primitive root; KJV: have enough, fill (full, self, with), be (to the) full (of), have plenty of, be satiate, satisfy (with), suffice, be weary of.

H7647 שָׂבָע (sâbâʻ, saw-baw'): copiousness. Origin: from H7646 (שָׂבַע); KJV: abundance, plenteous(-ness, -ly).

H7648 שֹׂבַע (sôbaʻ, so'-bah): satisfaction (of food or (figuratively) joy). Origin: from H7646 (שָׂבַע); KJV: fill, full(-ness), satisfying, be satisfied.

H7649 שָׂבֵעַ (sâbêaʻ, saw-bay'-ah): satiated (in a pleasant or disagreeable sense). Origin: from H7646 (שָׂבַע); KJV: full (of), satisfied (with).

H7650 שָׁבַע (shâbaʻ, shaw-bah'): to seven oneself, i.e. swear (as if by repeating a declaration seven times). Origin: a primitive root; properly to be complete, but used only as a denominative from H7651 (שֶׁבַע); KJV: adjure, charge (by an oath, with an oath), feed to the full (by mistake for H7646 (שָׂבַע)), take an oath, [idiom] straitly, (cause to, make to) swear.

H7651 שֶׁבַע (shebaʻ, sheh'-bah): seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number. Origin: or (masculine) (שִׁבְעָה); from H7650 (שָׁבַע); a primitive cardinal number; KJV: ([phrase] by) seven(-fold),-s, (-teen, -teenth), -th, times). Compare H7658 (שִׁבְעָנָה).

H7652 שֶׁבַע (shebaʻ, sheh'-bah): Sheba, the name of a place in Palestine, and of two Israelites. Origin: the same as H7651 (שֶׁבַע); seven; KJV: Sheba.

H7653 שִׂבְעָה (sibʻâh, sib-aw'): satiety. Origin: feminine of H7647 (שָׂבָע); KJV: fulness.

H7654 שׇׂבְעָה (sobʻâh, sob-aw'): satiety. Origin: feminine of H7648 (שֹׂבַע); KJV: (to have) enough, [idiom] till...be full, (un-) satiable, satisfy, [idiom] sufficiently.

H7655 שִׁבְעָה (shibʻâh, shib-aw'): {seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number}. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7651 (שֶׁבַע) KJV: seven (times).

H7656 שִׁבְעָה (Shibʻâh, shib-aw'): Shebah, a well in Palestine. Origin: masculine of H7651 (שֶׁבַע); seven(-th); KJV: Shebah.

H7657 שִׁבְעִים (shibʻîym, shib-eem'): seventy. Origin: multiple of H7651 (שֶׁבַע); KJV: seventy, threescore and ten ([phrase] -teen).

H7658 שִׁבְעָנָה (shibʻânâh, shib-aw-naw'): seven. Origin: prolonged for the masculine of H7651 (שֶׁבַע); KJV: seven.

H7659 שִׁבְעָתַיִם (shibʻâthayim, shib-aw-thah'-yim): seven-times. Origin: dual (adverbially) of H7651 (שֶׁבַע); KJV: seven(-fold, times).

H7660 שָׁבַץ (shâbats, shaw-bats'): to interweave (colored) threads in squares; by implication (of reticulation) to inchase gems in gold. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: embroider, set.

H7661 שָׁבָץ (shâbâts, shaw-bawts'): entanglement, i.e. (figuratively) perplexity. Origin: from H7660 (שָׁבַץ); KJV: anguish.

H7662 שְׁבַק (shᵉbaq, sheb-ak'): to quit, i.e. allow to remain. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of H7733 (שׁוֹבֵק); KJV: leave, let alone.

H7663 שָׂבַר (sâbar, saw-bar'): to scrutinize; by implication (of watching) to expect (with hope and patience). Origin: erroneously שָׁבַר; (Nehemiah 2:13,15), a primitive root; KJV: hope, tarry, view, wait.

H7664 שֵׂבֶר (sêber, say'-ber): expectation. Origin: from H7663 (שָׂבַר); KJV: hope.

H7665 שָׁבַר (shâbar, shaw-bar'): to burst (literally or figuratively). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: break (down, off, in pieces, up), broken (-hearted), bring to the birth, crush, destroy, hurt, quench, [idiom] quite, tear, view (by mistake for H7663 (שָׂבַר)).

H7666 שָׁבַר (shâbar, shaw-bar'): to deal in grain. Origin: denominative from H7668 (שֶׁבֶר); KJV: buy, sell.

H7667 שֶׁבֶר (sheber, sheh'-ber): a fracture, figuratively, ruin; specifically, a solution (of a dream). Origin: or שֵׁבֶר; from H7665 (שָׁבַר); KJV: affliction, breach, breaking, broken(-footed, -handed), bruise, crashing, destruction, hurt, interpretation, vexation.

title: Strong's Hebrew Dictionary, H7668 to H7790
source: James Strong, A Concise Dictionary of the Words in the Hebrew Bible (1894), public domain; JSON edition by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA). Each entry: Strong number, Hebrew word, Latin reading, meaning, origin, how the KJV renders it.
body:
H7668 שֶׁבֶר (sheber, sheh'-ber): grain (as if broken into kernels). Origin: the same as H7667 (שֶׁבֶר); KJV: corn, victuals.

H7669 שֶׁבֶר (Sheber, sheh'-ber): Sheber, an Israelite. Origin: the same as H7667 (שֶׁבֶר); KJV: Sheber.

H7670 שִׁבְרוֹן (shibrôwn, shib-rone'): rupture, i.e. a pang; figuratively, ruin. Origin: from H7665 (שָׁבַר); KJV: breaking, destruction.

H7671 שְׁבָרִים (Shᵉbârîym, sheb-aw-reem'): Shebarim, a place in Palestine. Origin: plural of H7667 (שֶׁבֶר); ruins; KJV: Shebarim.

H7672 שְׁבַשׁ (shᵉbash, sheb-ash'): to entangle, i.e. perplex. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7660 (שָׁבַץ); KJV: be astonished.

H7673 שָׁבַת (shâbath, shaw-bath'): to repose, i.e. desist from exertion; used in many implied relations (causative, figurative or specific). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (cause to, let, make to) cease, celebrate, cause (make) to fail, keep (sabbath), suffer to be lacking, leave, put away (down), (make to) rest, rid, still, take away.

H7674 שֶׁבֶת (shebeth, sheh'-beth): rest, interruption, cessation. Origin: from H7673 (שָׁבַת); KJV: cease, sit still, loss of time.

H7675 שֶׁבֶת (shebeth, sheh'-beth): properly, session; but used also concretely, an abode or locality. Origin: infinitive of H3427 (יָשַׁב); KJV: place, seat. Compare H3429 (יֹשֵׁב בַּשֶּׁבֶת).

H7676 שַׁבָּת (shabbâth, shab-bawth'): intermission, i.e (specifically) the Sabbath. Origin: intensive from H7673 (שָׁבַת); KJV: ([phrase] every) sabbath.

H7677 שַׁבָּתוֹן (shabbâthôwn, shab-baw-thone'): a sabbatism or special holiday. Origin: from H7676 (שַׁבָּת); KJV: rest, sabbath.

H7678 שַׁבְּתַי (Shabbᵉthay, shab-beth-ah'-ee): Shabbethai, the name of three Israelites. Origin: from H7676 (שַׁבָּת); restful; KJV: Shabbethai.

H7679 שָׂגָא (sâgâʼ, saw-gaw'): to grow, i.e. (causatively) to enlarge, (figuratively) laud. Origin: ; a primitive root; KJV: increase, magnify.

H7680 שְׂגָא (sᵉgâʼ, seg-aw'): to increase. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7679 (שָׂגָא); KJV: grow, be multiplied.

H7681 שָׁגֶא (Shâgeʼ, shaw-gay'): Shage, an Israelite. Origin: probably from H7686 (שָׁגָה); erring; KJV: Shage.

H7682 שָׂגַב (sâgab, saw-gab'): to be (causatively, make) lofty, especially inaccessible; by implication, safe, strong; used literally and figuratively. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: defend, exalt, be excellent, (be, set on) high, lofty, be safe, set up (on high), be too strong.

H7683 שָׁגַג (shâgag, shaw-gag'): to stray, i.e. (figuratively) sin (with more or less apology). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: [idiom] also for that, deceived, err, go astray, sin ignorantly.

H7684 שְׁגָגָה (shᵉgâgâh, sheg-aw-gaw'): a mistake or inadvertent transgression. Origin: from H7683 (שָׁגַג); KJV: error, ignorance, at unawares; unwittingly.

H7685 שָׂגָה (sâgâh, saw-gaw'): to enlarge (especially upward, also figuratively). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: grow (up), increase.

H7686 שָׁגָה (shâgâh, shaw-gaw'): to stray (causatively, mislead), usually (figuratively) to mistake, especially (morally) to transgress; by extension (through the idea of intoxication) to reel, (figuratively) be enraptured. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (cause to) go astray, deceive, err, be ravished, sin through ignorance, (let, make to) wander.

H7687 שְׂגוּב (Sᵉgûwb, seg-oob'): Segub, the name of two Israelites. Origin: from H7682 (שָׂגַב); aloft; KJV: Segub.

H7688 שָׁגַח (shâgach, shaw-gakh'): to peep, i.e. glance sharply at. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: look (narrowly).

H7689 שַׂגִּיא (saggîyʼ, sag-ghee'): (superlatively) mighty. Origin: from H7679 (שָׂגָא); KJV: excellent, great.

H7690 שַׂגִּיא (saggîyʼ, sag-ghee'): large (in size, quantity or number, also adverbial). Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7689 (שַׂגִּיא); KJV: exceeding, great(-ly); many, much, sore, very.

H7691 שְׁגִיאָה (shᵉgîyʼâh, sheg-ee-aw'): a moral mistake. Origin: from H7686 (שָׁגָה); KJV: error.

H7692 שִׁגָּיוֹן (shiggâyôwn, shig-gaw-yone'): properly, aberration, i.e. (technically) a dithyramb or rambling poem. Origin: or שִׁגָּיֹנָה; from H7686 (שָׁגָה); KJV: Shiggaion, Shigionoth.

H7693 שָׁגַל (shâgal, shaw-gal'): to copulate with. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: lie with, ravish.

H7694 שֵׁגָל (shêgâl, shay-gawl'): a queen (from cohabitation). Origin: from H7693 (שָׁגַל); KJV: queen.

H7695 שֵׁגָל (shêgâl, shay-gawl'): a (legitimate) queen. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7694 (שֵׁגָל); KJV: wife.

H7696 שָׁגַע (shâgaʻ, shaw-gah'): to rave through insanity. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (be, play the) mad (man).

H7697 שִׁגָּעוֹן (shiggâʻôwn, shig-gaw-yone'): craziness. Origin: from H7696 (שָׁגַע); KJV: furiously, madness.

H7698 שֶׁגֶר (sheger, sheh'-ger): the fetus (as finally expelled). Origin: from an unused root probably meaning to eject; KJV: that cometh of, increase.

H7699 שַׁד (shad, shad): the breast of a woman or animal (as bulging). Origin: or שֹׁד; probably from H7736 (שׁוּד) (in its original sense) contracted; KJV: breast, pap, teat.

H7700 שֵׁד (shêd, shade): a doemon (as malignant). Origin: from H7736 (שׁוּד); KJV: devil.

H7701 שֹׁד (shôd, shode): violence, ravage. Origin: or שׁוֹד; (Job 5:21), from H7736 (שׁוּד); KJV: desolation, destruction, oppression, robbery, spoil(-ed, -er, -ing), wasting.

H7702 שָׂדַד (sâdad, saw-dad'): to abrade, i.e. harrow afield. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: break clods, harrow.

H7703 שָׁדַד (shâdad, shaw-dad'): properly, to be burly, i.e. (figuratively) powerful (passively, impregnable); by implication, to ravage. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: dead, destroy(-er), oppress, robber, spoil(-er), [idiom] utterly, (lay) waste.

H7704 שָׂדֶה (sâdeh, saw-deh'): a field (as flat). Origin: or שָׂדַי; from an unused root meaning to spread out; KJV: country, field, ground, land, soil, [idiom] wild.

H7705 שִׁדָּה (shiddâh, shid-dah'): a wife (as mistress of the house). Origin: from H7703 (שָׁדַד); KJV: [idiom] all sorts, musical instrument.

H7706 שַׁדַּי (Shadday, shad-dah'-ee): the Almighty. Origin: from H7703 (שָׁדַד); KJV: Almighty.

H7707 שְׁדֵיאוּר (Shᵉdêyʼûwr, shed-ay-oor'): Shedejur, an Israelite. Origin: from the same as H7704 (שָׂדֶה) and H217 (אוּר); spreader of light; KJV: Shedeur.

H7708 שִׂדִּים (Siddîym, sid-deem'): Siddim, a valley in Palestine. Origin: plural from the same as H7704 (שָׂדֶה); flats; KJV: Siddim.

H7709 שְׁדֵמָה (shᵉdêmâh, shed-ay-maw'): a cultivated field. Origin: apparently from H7704 (שָׂדֶה); KJV: blasted, field.

H7710 שָׁדַף (shâdaph, shaw-daf'): to scorch. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: blast.

H7711 שְׁדֵפָה (shᵉdêphâh, shed-ay-faw'): blight. Origin: or שִׁדָּפוֹן; from H7710 (שָׁדַף); KJV: blasted(-ing).

H7712 שְׁדַר (shᵉdar, shed-ar'): to endeavor. Origin: (Aramaic) a primitive root; KJV: labour.

H7713 שְׂדֵרָה (sᵉdêrâh, sed-ay-raw'): a row, i.e. rank (of soldiers), story (of rooms). Origin: from an unused root meaning to regulate; KJV: board, range.

H7714 שַׁדְרַךְ (Shadrak, shad-rak'): Shadrak, the Babylonian name of one of Daniel's companions. Origin: probably of foreign origin; KJV: Shadrach.

H7715 שַׁדְרַךְ (Shadrak, shad-rak'): {Shadrak, the Babylonian name of one of Daniel's companions}. Origin: (Aramaic) the same as H7714 (שַׁדְרַךְ) KJV: Shadrach.

H7716 שֶׂה (seh, seh): a member of a flock, i.e. a sheep or goat. Origin: or שֵׂי; probably from H7582 (שָׁאָה) through the idea of pushing out to graze; KJV: (lesser, small) cattle, ewe, goat, lamb, sheep. Compare H2089 (זֶה).

H7717 שָׂהֵד (sâhêd, saw-hade'): a witness. Origin: from an unused root meaning to testify; KJV: record.

H7718 שֹׁהַם (shôham, sho'-ham): a gem, probably the beryl (from its pale green color). Origin: from an unused root probably mean to blanch; KJV: onyx.

H7719 שֹׁהַם (Shôham, sho'-ham): Shoham, an Israelite. Origin: the same as H7718 (שֹׁהַם); KJV: Shoham.

H7720 שַׂהֲרֹן (sahărôn, sah-har-one'): a round pendant for the neck. Origin: from the same as H5469 (סַהַר); KJV: ornament, round tire like the moon.

H7721 שׂוֹא (sôwʼ, so): a rising. Origin: from an unused root (akin to H5375 (נָשָׂא) and H7722 (שׁוֹא)) meaning to rise; KJV: arise.

H7722 שׁוֹא (shôwʼ, sho): a tempest; by implication, devastation. Origin: or (feminine) שׁוֹאָה; or שֹׁאָה; from an unused root meaning to rush over; KJV: desolate(-ion), destroy, destruction, storm, wasteness.

H7723 שָׁוְא (shâvᵉʼ, shawv): evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjective), uselessness (as deceptive, objective; also adverbially, in vain). Origin: or שַׁו; from the same as H7722 (שׁוֹא) in the sense of desolating; KJV: false(-ly), lie, lying, vain, vanity.

H7724 שְׁוָא (Shᵉvâʼ, shev-aw'): Sheva, an Israelite. Origin: from the same as H7723 (שָׁוְא); false; KJV: Sheva.

H7725 שׁוּב (shûwb, shoob): to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: ((break, build, circumcise, dig, do anything, do evil, feed, lay down, lie down, lodge, make, rejoice, send, take, weep)) [idiom] again, (cause to) answer ([phrase] again), [idiom] in any case (wise), [idiom] at all, averse, bring (again, back, home again), call (to mind), carry again (back), cease, [idiom] certainly, come again (back), [idiom] consider, [phrase] continually, convert, deliver (again), [phrase] deny, draw back, fetch home again, [idiom] fro, get (oneself) (back) again, [idiom] give (again), go again (back, home), (go) out, hinder, let, (see) more, [idiom] needs, be past, [idiom] pay, pervert, pull in again, put (again, up again), recall, recompense, recover, refresh, relieve, render (again), requite, rescue, restore, retrieve, (cause to, make to) return, reverse, reward, [phrase] say nay, send back, set again, slide back, still, [idiom] surely, take back (off), (cause to, make to) turn (again, self again, away, back, back again, backward, from, off), withdraw.

H7726 שׁוֹבָב (shôwbâb, sho-bawb'): apostate, i.e. idolatrous. Origin: from H7725 (שׁוּב); KJV: backsliding, frowardly, turn away (from margin).

H7727 שׁוֹבָב (Shôwbâb, sho-bawb'): Shobab, the name of two Israelites. Origin: the same as H7726 (שׁוֹבָב); rebellious; KJV: Shobab.

H7728 שׁוֹבֵב (shôwbêb, sho-babe'): apostate, i.e. heathenish or (actually) heathen. Origin: from H7725 (שׁוּב); KJV: backsliding.

H7729 שׁוּבָה (shûwbâh, shoo-baw'): a return. Origin: from H7725 (שׁוּב); KJV: returning.

H7730 שׂוֹבֶךְ (sôwbek, so'-bek): a thicket, i.e. interlaced branches. Origin: for H5441 (סֹבֶךְ); KJV: thick boughs.

H7731 שׁוֹבָךְ (Shôwbâk, sho-bawk'): Shobak, a Syrian. Origin: perhaps for H7730 (שׂוֹבֶךְ); KJV: Shobach.

H7732 שׁוֹבָל (Shôwbâl, sho-bawl'): Shobal, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites. Origin: from the same as H7640 (שֹׁבֶל); overflowing; KJV: Shobal.

H7733 שׁוֹבֵק (Shôwbêq, sho-bake'): Shobek, an Israelite. Origin: active participle from a primitive root meaning to leave (compare H7662 (שְׁבַק)); forsaking; KJV: Shobek.

H7734 שׂוּג (sûwg, soog): to retreat. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: turn back.

H7735 שׂוּג (sûwg, soog): to hedge in. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: make to grow.

H7736 שׁוּד (shûwd, shood): properly, to swell up, i.e. figuratively (by implication of insolence) to devastate. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: waste.

H7737 שָׁוָה (shâvâh, shaw-vaw'): properly, to level, i.e. equalize; figuratively, to resemble; by implication, to adjust (i.e. counterbalance, be suitable, compose, place, yield, etc.). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: avail, behave, bring forth, compare, countervail, (be, make) equal, lay, be (make, a-) like, make plain, profit, reckon.

H7738 שָׁוָה (shâvâh, shaw-vaw'): to destroy. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: [idiom] substance (from the margin).

H7739 שְׁוָה (shᵉvâh, shev-aw'): to resemble. Origin: (Aramaic); corresponding to H7737 (שָׁוָה); KJV: make like.

H7740 שָׁוֵה (Shâvêh, shaw-vay'): Shaveh, a place in Palestine. Origin: from H7737 (שָׁוָה); plain; KJV: Shaveh.

H7741 שָׁוֵה קִרְיָתַיִם (Shâvêh Qiryâthayim, shaw-vay' kir-yawthah'-yim): Shaveh-Kirjathajim, a place East of the Jordan. Origin: from the same as H7740 (שָׁוֵה) and the dual of H7151 (קִרְיָה); plain of a double city; KJV: Shaveh Kiriathaim.

H7742 שׂוּחַ (sûwach, soo'-akh): to muse pensively. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: meditate.

H7743 שׁוּחַ (shûwach, shoo'-akh): to sink, literally or figuratively. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: bow down, incline, humble.

H7744 שׁוּחַ (Shûwach, shoo'-akh): Shuach, a son of Abraham. Origin: from H7743 (שׁוּחַ); dell; KJV: Shuah.

H7745 שׁוּחָה (shûwchâh, shoo-khaw'): a chasm. Origin: from H7743 (שׁוּחַ); KJV: ditch, pit.

H7746 שׁוּחָה (Shûwchâh, shoo-khaw'): Shuchah, an Israelite. Origin: the same as H7745 (שׁוּחָה); KJV: Shuah.

H7747 שׁוּחִי (Shûwchîy, shoo-khee'): a Shuchite or descendant of Shuach. Origin: patronymic from H7744 (שׁוּחַ); KJV: Shuhite.

H7748 שׁוּחָם (Shûwchâm, shoo-khawm'): Shucham, an Israelite. Origin: from H7743 (שׁוּחַ); humbly; KJV: Shuham.

H7749 שׁוּחָמִי (Shûwchâmîy, shoo-khaw-mee'): a Shuchamite (collectively). Origin: patronymic from H7748 (שׁוּחָם); KJV: Shuhamites.

H7750 שׂוּט (sûwṭ, soot): to detrude, i.e. (intransitively and figuratively) become derelict (wrongly practise; namely, idolatry). Origin: or (by permutation) סוּט; a primitive root; KJV: turn aside to.

H7751 שׁוּט (shûwṭ, shoot): properly, to push forth; (but used only figuratively) to lash, i.e. (the sea with oars) to row; by implication, to travel. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: go (about, through, to and fro), mariner, rower, run to and fro.

H7752 שׁוֹט (shôwṭ, shote): a lash (literally or figuratively). Origin: from H7751 (שׁוּט); KJV: scourge, whip.

H7753 שׂוּךְ (sûwk, sook): to entwine, i.e. shut in (for formation, protection or restraint). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: fence, (make an) hedge (up).

H7754 שׂוֹךְ (sôwk, soke): a branch (as interleaved). Origin: or (feminine) שׂוֹכָה; from H7753 (שׂוּךְ); KJV: bough.

H7755 שׂוֹכֹה (Sôwkôh, so-ko'): Sokoh or Soko, the name of two places in Palestine. Origin: or שֹׂכֹה; or שׂוֹכוֹ; from H7753 (שׂוּךְ); KJV: Shocho, Shochoh, Sochoh, Soco, Socoh.

H7756 שׂוּכָתִי (Sûwkâthîy, soo-kaw-thee'): a Sukathite or descendant of an unknown Israelite named Sukah. Origin: probably patronymic from a name corresponding to H7754 (שׂוֹךְ) (feminine); KJV: Suchathite.

H7757 שׁוּל (shûwl, shool): a skirt; by implication, a bottom edge. Origin: from an unused root meaning to hang down; KJV: hem, skirt, train.

H7758 שׁוֹלָל (shôwlâl, sho-lawl'): nude (especially bare-foot); by implication, captive. Origin: or שֵׁילָל; (Micah 1:8), from H7997 (שָׁלַל); KJV: spoiled, stripped.

H7759 שׁוּלַמִּית (Shûwlammîyth, shoo-lam-meeth'): peaceful (with the article always prefixed, making it a pet name); the Shulammith, an epithet of Solomon's queen. Origin: from H7999 (שָׁלַם); KJV: Shulamite.

H7760 שׂוּם (sûwm, soom): to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically). Origin: or שִׂים; a primitive root; KJV: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, [phrase] disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, [phrase] name, [idiom] on, ordain, order, [phrase] paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), [phrase] regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, [phrase] stedfastly, take, [idiom] tell, [phrase] tread down, (over-)turn, [idiom] wholly, work.

H7761 שׂוּם (sûwm, soom): {to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)}. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7760 (שׂוּם) KJV: [phrase] command, give, lay, make, [phrase] name, [phrase] regard, set.

H7762 שׁוּם (shûwm, shoom): garlic (from its rank odor). Origin: from an unused root meaning to exhale; KJV: garlic.

H7763 שׁוֹמֵר (Shôwmêr, sho-mare'): Shomer, the name of two Israelites. Origin: or שֹׁמֵר; active participle of H8104 (שָׁמַר); keeper; KJV: Shomer.

H7764 שׁוּנִי (Shûwnîy, shoo-nee'): Shuni, an Israelite. Origin: from an unused root meaning to rest; quiet; KJV: Shuni.

H7765 שׁוּנִי (Shûwnîy, shoo-nee'): a Shunite (collectively) or descendants of Shuni. Origin: patronymic from H7764 (שׁוּנִי); KJV: Shunites.

H7766 שׁוּנֵם (Shûwnêm, shoo-name'): Shunem, a place in Pal. Origin: probably from the same as H7764 (שׁוּנִי); quietly; KJV: Shunem.

H7767 שׁוּנַמִּית (Shûwnammîyth, shoo-nam-meeth'): a Shunammitess, or female inhabitant of Shunem. Origin: patrial from H7766 (שׁוּנֵם); KJV: Shunamite.

H7768 שָׁוַע (shâvaʻ, shaw-vah'): properly, to be free; but used only causatively and reflexively, to halloo (for help, i.e. freedom from some trouble). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: cry (aloud, out), shout.

H7769 שׁוּעַ (shûwaʻ, shoo'-ah): a halloo. Origin: from H7768 (שָׁוַע); KJV: cry, riches.

H7770 שׁוּעַ (Shûwaʻ, shoo'-ah): Shua, a Canaanite. Origin: the same as H7769 (שׁוּעַ); KJV: Shua, Shuah.

H7771 שׁוֹעַ (shôwaʻ, sho'-ah): a noble, i.e. liberal, opulent; also (as noun in the derived sense) a halloo. Origin: from H7768 (שָׁוַע) in the original sense of freedom; KJV: bountiful, crying, rich.

H7772 שׁוֹעַ (Shôwaʻ, sho'-ah): Shoa, an Oriental people. Origin: the same as H7771 (שׁוֹעַ); rich; KJV: Shoa.

H7773 שֶׁוַע (shevaʻ, sheh'-vah): a halloo. Origin: from H7768 (שָׁוַע); KJV: cry.

H7774 שׁוּעָא (Shûwʻâʼ, shoo-aw'): Shua, an Israelitess. Origin: from H7768 (שָׁוַע); wealth; KJV: Shua.

H7775 שַׁוְעָה (shavʻâh, shav-aw'): a hallooing. Origin: feminine of H7773 (שֶׁוַע); KJV: crying.

H7776 שׁוּעָל (shûwʻâl, shoo-awl'): a jackal (as a burrower). Origin: or שֻׁעָל; from the same as H8168 (שֹׁעַל); KJV: fox.

H7777 שׁוּעָל (Shûwʻâl, shoo-awl'): Shual, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine. Origin: the same as H7776 (שׁוּעָל); KJV: Shual.

H7778 שׁוֹעֵר (shôwʻêr, sho-are'): a janitor. Origin: or שֹׁעֵר active participle of H8176 (שָׁעַר) (as denominative from H8179 (שַׁעַר)); KJV: doorkeeper, porter.

H7779 שׁוּף (shûwph, shoof): properly, to gape, i.e. snap at; figuratively, to overwhelm. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: break, bruise, cover.

H7780 שׁוֹפָךְ (Shôwphâk, sho-fawk'): Shophak, a Syrian. Origin: from H8210 (שָׁפַךְ); poured; KJV: Shophach.

H7781 שׁוּפָמִי (Shûwphâmîy, shoo-faw-mee'): a Shuphamite (collectively) or descendants of Shephupham. Origin: patronymic from H8197 (שְׁפוּפָם); KJV: Shuphamite.

H7782 שׁוֹפָר (shôwphâr, sho-far'): a cornet (as giving a clear sound) or curved horn. Origin: or שֹׁפָר; from H8231 (שָׁפַר) in the original sense of incising; KJV: cornet, trumpet.

H7783 שׁוּק (shûwq, shook): to run after or over, i.e. overflow. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: overflow, water.

H7784 שׁוּק (shûwq, shook): a street (as run over). Origin: from H7783 (שׁוּק); KJV: street.

H7785 שׁוֹק (shôwq, shoke): the (lower) leg (as a runner). Origin: from H7783 (שׁוּק); KJV: hip, leg, shoulder, thigh.

H7786 שׂוּר (sûwr, soor): properly, to vanquish; by implication, to rule (causatively, crown). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: make princes, have power, reign. See H5493 (סוּר).

H7787 שׂוּר (sûwr, soor): to saw. Origin: a primitive root (identical with H7786 (שׂוּר) through the idea of reducing to pieces; compare H4883 (מַשּׂוֹר)); KJV: cut.

H7788 שׁוּר (shûwr, shoor): properly, to turn, i.e. travel about (as a harlot or a merchant). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: go, singular See also H7891 (שִׁיר).

H7789 שׁוּר (shûwr, shoor): to spy out, i.e. (generally) survey, (for evil) lurk for, (for good) care for. Origin: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of going round for inspection); KJV: behold, lay wait, look, observe, perceive, regard, see.

H7790 שׁוּר (shûwr, shoor): a foe (as lying in wait). Origin: from H7889 (שִׁימוֹן); KJV: enemy.

title: Strong's Hebrew Dictionary, H7791 to H7920
source: James Strong, A Concise Dictionary of the Words in the Hebrew Bible (1894), public domain; JSON edition by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA). Each entry: Strong number, Hebrew word, Latin reading, meaning, origin, how the KJV renders it.
body:
H7791 שׁוּר (shûwr, shoor): a wall (as going about). Origin: from H7788 (שׁוּר); KJV: wall.

H7792 שׁוּר (shûwr, shoor): {a wall (as going about)}. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7791 (שׁוּר) KJV: wall.

H7793 שׁוּר (Shûwr, shoor): Shur, a region of the Desert. Origin: the same as H7791 (שׁוּר); KJV: Shur.

H7794 שׁוֹר (shôwr, shore): a bullock (as a traveller). Origin: from H7788 (שׁוּר); KJV: bull(-ock), cow, ox, wall (by mistake for H7791 (שׁוּר)).

H7795 שׂוֹרָה (sôwrâh, so-raw'): properly, a ring, i.e. (by analogy) a row (adverbially). Origin: from H7786 (שׂוּר) in the primitive sense of H5493 (סוּר); KJV: principal.

H7796 שׂוֹרֵק (Sôwrêq, so-rake'): Sorek, a valley in Palestine. Origin: the same as H8321 (שֹׂרֵק); a vine; KJV: Sorek.

H7797 שׂוּשׂ (sûws, soos): to be bright, i.e. cheerful. Origin: or שִׂישׂ; a primitive root; KJV: be glad, [idiom] greatly, joy, make mirth, rejoice.

H7798 שַׁוְשָׁא (Shavshâʼ, shav-shaw'): Shavsha, an Israelite. Origin: from H7797 (שׂוּשׂ); joyful; KJV: Shavsha.

H7799 שׁוּשַׁן (shûwshan, shoo-shan'): a lily (from its whiteness), as aflower of architectural ornament; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape). Origin: or שׁוֹשָׁן; or שֹׁשָׁן; and (feminine) שׁוֹשַׁנָּה; from H7797 (שׂוּשׂ); KJV: lily, Shoshannim.

H7800 שׁוּשַׁן (Shûwshan, shoo-shan'): Shushan, a place in Persia. Origin: the same as H7799 (שׁוּשַׁן); KJV: Shushan.

H7801 שׁוּשַׁנְכִי (Shûwshankîy, shoo-shan-kee'): a Shushankite (collectively) or inhabitants of some unknown place in Assyrian. Origin: (Aramaic) of foreign origin; KJV: Susanchites.

H7802 שׁוּשַׁן עֵדוּת (Shûwshan ʻÊdûwth, shoo-shan' ay-dooth'): Shushan-Eduth or Shoshannim-Eduth, the title of a popular song. Origin: or (plural of former) שׁוֹשַׁנִּים עֵדוּתlemma שׁוֹשַׁנִּיס עֵדוּת samekh, corrected to שׁוֹשַׁנִּים עֵדוּת; from H7799 (שׁוּשַׁן) and H5715 (עֵדוּת); lily (or trumpet) of assemblage; KJV: Shoshannim-Eduth, Shushan-eduth.

H7803 שׁוּתֶלַח (Shûwthelach, shoo-theh'-lakh): Shuthelach, the name of two Israelites. Origin: probably from H7582 (שָׁאָה) and the same as H8520 (תֶּלַח); crash of breakage; KJV: Shuthelah.

H7804 שְׁזַב (shᵉzab, shez-ab'): to leave, i.e. (causatively) free. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5800 (עָזַב); KJV: deliver.

H7805 שָׁזַף (shâzaph, shaw-zaf'): to tan (by sunburning); figuratively (as if by a piercing ray) to scan. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: look up, see.

H7806 שָׁזַר (shâzar, shaw-zar'): to twist (a thread of straw). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: twine.

H7807 שַׁח (shach, shakh): sunk, i.e. downcast. Origin: from H7817 (שָׁחַח); KJV: [phrase] humble.

H7808 שֵׂחַ (sêach, say'-akh): communion, i.e. (reflexively) meditation. Origin: for H7879 (שִׂיחַ); KJV: thought.

H7809 שָׁחַד (shâchad, shaw-khad'): to donate, i.e. bribe. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: hire, give a reward.

H7810 שַׁחַד (shachad, shakh'-ad): a donation (venal or redemptive). Origin: from H7809 (שָׁחַד); KJV: bribe(-ry), gift, present, reward.

H7811 שָׂחָה (sâchâh, saw-khaw'): to swim; causatively, to inundate. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (make to) swim.

H7812 שָׁחָה (shâchâh, shaw-khaw'): to depress, i.e. prostrate (especially reflexive, in homage to royalty or God). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: bow (self) down, crouch, fall down (flat), humbly beseech, do (make) obeisance, do reverence, make to stoop, worship.

H7813 שָׂחוּ (sâchûw, saw'-khoo): a pond (for swimming). Origin: from H7811 (שָׂחָה); KJV: to swim in.

H7814 שְׂחוֹק (sᵉchôwq, sekh-oke'): laughter (in merriment or defiance). Origin: or שְׂחֹק; from H7832 (שָׂחַק); KJV: derision, laughter(-ed to scorn, -ing), mocked, sport.

H7815 שְׁחוֹר (shᵉchôwr, shekh-ore'): dinginess, i.e. perhaps soot. Origin: from H7835 (שָׁחַר); KJV: coal.

H7816 שְׁחוּת (shᵉchûwth, shekh-ooth'): pit. Origin: from H7812 (שָׁחָה); KJV: pit.

H7817 שָׁחַח (shâchach, shaw-khakh'): to sink or depress (reflexive or causative). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: bend, bow (down), bring (cast) down, couch, humble self, be (bring) low, stoop.

H7818 שָׂחַט (sâchaṭ, saw-khat'): to tread out, i.e. squeeze (grapes). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: press.

H7819 שָׁחַט (shâchaṭ, shaw-khat'): to slaughter (in sacrifice or massacre). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: kill, offer, shoot out, slay, slaughter.

H7820 שָׁחַט (shâchaṭ, shaw-khat'): to hammer out. Origin: a primitive root (identical with H7819 (שָׁחַט) through the idea of striking); KJV: beat.

H7821 שְׁחִיטָה (shᵉchîyṭâh, shekh-ee-taw'): slaughter. Origin: from H7819 (שָׁחַט); KJV: killing.

H7822 שְׁחִין (shᵉchîyn, shekh-een'): inflammation, i.e. an ulcer. Origin: from an unused root probably meaning to burn; KJV: boil, botch.

H7823 שָׁחִיס (shâchîyç, shaw-khece'): aftergrowth. Origin: or סָחִישׁ; from an unused root apparently meaning to sprout; KJV: (that) which springeth of the same.

H7824 שָׁחִיף (shâchîyph, shaw-kheef'): a board (as chipped thin). Origin: from the same as H7828 (שַׁחַף); KJV: cieled with.

H7825 שְׁחִית (shᵉchîyth, shekh-eeth'): a pit-fall (literally or figuratively). Origin: from H7812 (שָׁחָה); KJV: destruction, pit.

H7826 שַׁחַל (shachal, shakh'-al): a lion (from his characteristic roar). Origin: from an unused root probably meaning to roar; KJV: (fierce) lion.

H7827 שְׁחֵלֶת (shᵉchêleth, shekh-ay'-leth): a scale or shell, i.e. the aromatic mussel. Origin: apparently from the same as H7826 (שַׁחַל) through some obscure idea, perhaps that of peeling off by concussion of sound; KJV: onycha.

H7828 שַׁחַף (shachaph, shakh'-af): the gull (as thin). Origin: from an unused root meaning to peel, i.e. emaciate; KJV: cuckoo.

H7829 שַׁחֶפֶת (shachepheth, shakh-eh'-feth): emaciation. Origin: from the same as H7828 (שַׁחַף); KJV: consumption.

H7830 שַׁחַץ (shachats, shakh'-ats): haughtiness (as evinced by the attitude). Origin: from an unused root apparently meaning to strut; KJV: [idiom] lion, pride.

H7831 שַׁחֲצוֹם (Shachătsôwm, shakh-ats-ome'): Shachatsom, a place in Palestine. Origin: from the same as H7830 (שַׁחַץ); proudly; KJV: Shahazimah (from the margin).

H7832 שָׂחַק (sâchaq, saw-khak'): to laugh (in pleasure or detraction); by implication, to play. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: deride, have in derision, laugh, make merry, mock(-er), play, rejoice, (laugh to) scorn, be in (make) sport.

H7833 שָׁחַק (shâchaq, shaw-khak'): to comminate (by trituration or attrition). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: beat, wear.

H7834 שַׁחַק (shachaq, shakh'-ak): a powder (as beaten small); by analogy, a thin vapor; by extension, the firmament. Origin: from H7833 (שָׁחַק); KJV: cloud, small dust, heaven, sky.

H7835 שָׁחַר (shâchar, shaw-khar'): to be dim or dark (in color). Origin: a primitive root (identical with H7836 (שָׁחַר) through the idea of the duskiness of early dawn); KJV: be black.

H7836 שָׁחַר (shâchar, shaw-khar'): properly, to dawn, i.e. (figuratively) be (up) early at any task (with the implication of earnestness); by extension, to search for (with painstaking). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (do something) betimes, enquire early, rise (seek) betimes, seek diligently) early, in the morning).

H7837 שַׁחַר (shachar, shakh'-ar): dawn (literal, figurative or adverbial). Origin: from H7836 (שָׁחַר); KJV: day(-spring), early, light, morning, whence riseth.

H7838 שָׁחֹר (shâchôr, shaw-khore'): properly, dusky, but also (absol.) jetty. Origin: or שָׁחוֹר; from H7835 (שָׁחַר); KJV: black.

H7839 שַׁחֲרוּת (shachărûwth, shakh-ar-ooth'): a dawning, i.e. (figuratively) juvenescence. Origin: from H7836 (שָׁחַר); KJV: youth.

H7840 שְׁחַרְחֹרֶת (shᵉcharchôreth, shekh-ar-kho'-reth): swarthy. Origin: from H7835 (שָׁחַר); KJV: black.

H7841 שְׁחַרְיָה (Shᵉcharyâh, shekh-ar-yaw'): Shecharjah, an Israelite. Origin: from H7836 (שָׁחַר) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has sought; KJV: Shehariah.

H7842 שַׁחֲרַיִם (Shachărayim, shakh-ar-ah'-yim): Shacharajim, an Israelite. Origin: dual of H7837 (שַׁחַר); double dawn; KJV: Shaharaim.

H7843 שָׁחַת (shâchath, shaw-khath'): to decay, i.e. (causatively) ruin (literally or figuratively). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: batter, cast off, corrupt(-er, thing), destroy(-er, -uction), lose, mar, perish, spill, spoiler, [idiom] utterly, waste(-r).

H7844 שְׁחַת (shᵉchath, shekh-ath'): {to decay, i.e. (causatively) ruin (literally or figuratively)}. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7843 (שָׁחַת) KJV: corrupt, fault.

H7845 שַׁחַת (shachath, shakh'-ath): a pit (especially as a trap); figuratively, destruction. Origin: from H7743 (שׁוּחַ); KJV: corruption, destruction, ditch, grave, pit.

H7846 שֵׂט (sêṭ, sayte): a departure from right, i.e. sin. Origin: or סֵט; from H7750 (שׂוּט); KJV: revolter, that turn aside.

H7847 שָׂטָה (sâṭâh, saw-taw'): to deviate from duty. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: decline, go aside, turn.

H7848 שִׁטָּה (shiṭṭâh, shit-taw'): the acacia (from its scourging thorns). Origin: feminine of a derivative (only in the plural שִׁטִּים; meaning the sticks of wood) from the same as H7850 (שֹׁטֵט); KJV: shittah, shittim. See also H1029 (בֵּית הַשִּׁטָּה).

H7849 שָׁטַח (shâṭach, shaw-takh'): to expand. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: all abroad, enlarge, spread, stretch out.

H7850 שֹׁטֵט (shôṭêṭ, sho-tate'): to flog; a goad. Origin: active participle of an otherwise unused root meaning (properly, to pierce; but only as a denominative from H7752 (שׁוֹט)) KJV: scourge.

H7851 שִׁטִּים (Shiṭṭîym, shit-teem'): Shittim, a place East of the Jordan. Origin: the same as the plural of H7848 (שִׁטָּה); acacia trees; KJV: Shittim.

H7852 שָׂטַם (sâṭam, saw-tam'): properly, to lurk for, i.e. persecute. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: hate, oppose self against.

H7853 שָׂטַן (sâṭan, saw-tan'): to attack, (figuratively) accuse. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (be an) adversary, resist.

H7854 שָׂטָן (sâṭân, saw-tawn'): an opponent; especially (with the article prefixed) Satan, the arch-enemy of good. Origin: from H7853 (שָׂטַן); KJV: adversary, Satan, withstand.

H7855 שִׂטְנָה (siṭnâh, sit-naw'): opposition (by letter). Origin: from H7853 (שָׂטַן); KJV: accusation.

H7856 שִׂטְנָה (Siṭnâh, sit-naw'): Sitnah, the name of a well in Pal. Origin: the same as H7855 (שִׂטְנָה); KJV: Sitnah.

H7857 שָׁטַף (shâṭaph, shaw-taf'): to gush; by implication, to inundate, cleanse; by analogy, to gallop, conquer. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: drown, (over-) flow(-whelm, rinse, run, rush, (throughly) wash (away).

H7858 שֶׁטֶף (sheṭeph, sheh'-tef): a deluge (literally or figuratively). Origin: or שֵׁטֶף; from H7857 (שָׁטַף); KJV: flood, outrageous, overflowing.

H7859 שְׁטַר (shᵉṭar, shet-ar'): a side. Origin: (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; KJV: side.

H7860 שֹׁטֵר (shôṭêr, sho-tare'): properly, a scribe, i.e. (by analogy or implication) an official superintendent or magistrate. Origin: active participle of an otherwise unused root probably meaning to write; KJV: officer, overseer, ruler.

H7861 שִׁטְרַי (Shiṭray, shit-rah'-ee): Shitrai, an Israelite. Origin: from the same as H7860 (שֹׁטֵר); magisterial; KJV: Shitrai.

H7862 שַׁי (shay, shah'-ee): a gift (as available). Origin: probably from H7737 (שָׁוָה); KJV: present.

H7863 שִׂיא (sîyʼ, see): elevation. Origin: from the same as H7721 (שׂוֹא) by permutation; KJV: excellency.

H7864 שְׁיָא (Shᵉyâʼ, sheh-yaw'): Sheja, an Israelite. Origin: for H7724 (שְׁוָא); KJV: Sheva (from the margin).

H7865 שִׂיאֹן (Sîyʼôn, see-ohn'): Sion, the summit of Mount Hermon. Origin: from H7863 (שִׂיא); peak; KJV: Sion.

H7866 שִׁיאוֹן (Shîyʼôwn, shee-ohn'): Shijon, a place in Palestine. Origin: from the same as H7722 (שׁוֹא); ruin; KJV: Shihon.

H7867 שִׂיב (sîyb, seeb): properly, to become aged, i.e. (by implication) to grow gray. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (be) grayheaded.

H7868 שִׂיב (sîyb, seeb): {properly, to become aged, i.e. (by implication) to grow gray}. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7867 (שִׂיב) KJV: elder.

H7869 שֵׂיב (sêyb, sabe): old age. Origin: from H7867 (שִׂיב); KJV: age.

H7870 שִׁיבָה (shîybâh, shee-baw'): a return (of property). Origin: by permutation from H7725 (שׁוּב); KJV: captivity.

H7871 שִׁיבָה (shîybâh, shee-baw'): residence. Origin: from H3427 (יָשַׁב); KJV: while...lay.

H7872 שֵׂיבָה (sêybâh, say-baw'): old age. Origin: feminine of H7869 (שֵׂיב); KJV: (be) gray (grey hoar,-y) hairs (head,-ed), old age.

H7873 שִׂיג (sîyg, seeg): a withdrawal (into a private place). Origin: from H7734 (שׂוּג); KJV: pursuing.

H7874 שִׂיד (sîyd, seed): to plaster. Origin: a primitive root probably meaning to boil up (compare H7736 (שׁוּד)); used only as denominative from H7875 (שִׂיד); KJV: plaister.

H7875 שִׂיד (sîyd, seed): lime (as boiling when slacked). Origin: from H7874 (שִׂיד)lemma שׂיד missing vowel, corrected to שִׂיד; KJV: lime, plaister.

H7876 שָׁיָה (shâyâh, shaw-yaw'): to keep in memory. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: be unmindful. (Render Deuteronomy 32:18, 'A Rock bore thee, thou must recollect; and (yet) thou hast forgotten,' etc.)

H7877 שִׁיזָא (Shîyzâʼ, shee-zaw'): Shiza, an Israelite. Origin: of unknown derivation; KJV: Shiza.

H7878 שִׂיחַ (sîyach, see'-akh): to ponder, i.e. (by implication) converse (with oneself, and hence, aloud) or (transitively) utter. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: commune, complain, declare, meditate, muse, pray, speak, talk (with).

H7879 שִׂיחַ (sîyach, see'-akh): a contemplation; by implication, an utterance. Origin: from H7878 (שִׂיחַ); KJV: babbling, communication, complaint, meditation, prayer, talk.

H7880 שִׂיחַ (sîyach, see'-akh): a shoot (as if uttered or put forth), i.e. (generally) shrubbery. Origin: from H7878 (שִׂיחַ); KJV: bush, plant, shrub.

H7881 שִׂיחָה (sîychâh, see-khaw'): reflection; be extension, devotion. Origin: feminine of H7879 (שִׂיחַ); KJV: meditation, prayer.

H7882 שִׁיחָה (shîychâh, shee-khaw'): a pit-fall. Origin: for H7745 (שׁוּחָה); KJV: pit.

H7883 שִׁיחוֹר (Shîychôwr, shee-khore'): Shichor, a stream of Egypt. Origin: or שִׁחוֹר; or שִׁחֹר; probably from H7835 (שָׁחַר); dark, i.e. turbid; KJV: Shihor, Sihor.

H7884 שִׁיחוֹר לִבְנָת (Shîychôwr Libnâth, shee-khore' lib-nawth'): Shichor-Libnath, a stream of Palestine. Origin: from the same as H7883 (שִׁיחוֹר) and H3835 (לָבַן); darkish whiteness; KJV: Shihor-libnath.

H7885 שַׁיִט (shayiṭ, shay'-yit): an oar; a scourge (figuratively). Origin: from H7751 (שׁוּט); also compare H7752 (שׁוֹט) KJV: oar, scourge.

H7886 שִׁילֹה (Shîylôh, shee-lo'): Shiloh, an epithet of the Messiah. Origin: from H7951 (שָׁלָה); tranquil; KJV: Shiloh.

H7887 שִׁילֹה (Shîylôh, shee-lo'): Shiloh, a place in Palestine. Origin: or שִׁלֹה; or שִׁילוֹ; or שִׁלוֹ; from the same as H7886 (שִׁילֹה); KJV: Shiloh.

H7888 שִׁילוֹנִי (Shîylôwnîy, shee-lo-nee'): a Shilonite or inhabitant of Shiloh. Origin: or שִׁילֹנִי; or שִׁלֹנִי; from H7887 (שִׁילֹה); KJV: Shilonite.

H7889 שִׁימוֹן (Shîymôwn, shee-mone'): Shimon, an Israelite. Origin: apparently for H3452 (יְשִׁימוֹן); desert; KJV: Shimon.

H7890 שַׁיִן (shayin, shah'-yin): urine. Origin: from an unused root meaning to urinate; KJV: piss.

H7891 שִׁיר (shîyr, sheer): to sing. Origin: or (the original form) שׁוּר; (1 Samuel 18:6), a primitive root (rather identical with H7788 (שׁוּר) through the idea of strolling minstrelsy); KJV: behold (by mistake for H7789 (שׁוּר)), sing(-er, -ing man, -ing woman).

H7892 שִׁיר (shîyr, sheer): a song; abstractly, singing. Origin: or feminine שִׁירָה; from H7891 (שִׁיר); KJV: musical(-ick), [idiom] sing(-er, -ing), song.

H7893 שַׁיִשׁ (shayish, shah'-yish): white, i.e. marble. Origin: from an unused root meaning to bleach, i.e. whiten; See H8336 (שֵׁשׁ).

H7894 שִׁישָׁא (Shîyshâʼ, shee-shaw'): Shisha, an Israelite. Origin: from the same as H7893 (שַׁיִשׁ); whiteness; KJV: Shisha.

H7895 שִׁישַׁק (Shîyshaq, shee-shak'): Shishak, an Egyptian king. Origin: or שׁוּשַׁק; of Egyptian derivation; KJV: Shishak.

H7896 שִׁית (shîyth, sheeth): to place (in a very wide application). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: apply, appoint, array, bring, consider, lay (up), let alone, [idiom] look, make, mark, put (on), [phrase] regard, set, shew, be stayed, [idiom] take.

H7897 שִׁית (shîyth, sheeth): a dress (as put on). Origin: from H7896 (שִׁית); KJV: attire.

H7898 שַׁיִת (shayith, shah'-yith): scrub or trash, i.e. wild growth of weeds or briers (as if put on the field). Origin: from H7896 (שִׁית); KJV: thorns.

H7899 שֵׂךְ (sêk, sake): a brier (as of a hedge). Origin: from H5526 (סָכַךְ) in the sense of H7753 (שׂוּךְ); KJV: prick.

H7900 שֹׂךְ (sôk, soke): a booth (as interlaced). Origin: from H5526 (סָכַךְ) in the sense of H7753 (שׂוּךְ); KJV: tabernacle.

H7901 שָׁכַב (shâkab, shaw-kab'): to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: [idiom] at all, cast down, (lover-)lay (self) (down), (make to) lie (down, down to sleep, still with), lodge, ravish, take rest, sleep, stay.

H7902 שְׁכָבָה (shᵉkâbâh, shek-aw-baw'): a lying down (of dew, or for the sexual act). Origin: from H7901 (שָׁכַב); KJV: [idiom] carnally, copulation, [idiom] lay, seed.

H7903 שְׁכֹבֶת (shᵉkôbeth, shek-o'-beth): a (sexual) lying with. Origin: from H7901 (שָׁכַב); KJV: [idiom] lie.

H7904 שָׁכָה (shâkâh, shaw-kaw'): to roam (through lust). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: in the morning (by mistake for H7925 (שָׁכַם)).

H7905 שֻׂכָּה (sukkâh, sook-kaw'): a dart (as pointed like a thorn). Origin: feminine of H7900 (שֹׂךְ) in the sense of H7899 (שֵׂךְ); KJV: barbed iron.

H7906 שֵׂכוּ (Sêkûw, say'-koo): Seku, a place in Palestine. Origin: from an unused root apparently meaning to surmount; an observatory (with the article); KJV: Sechu.

H7907 שֶׂכְוִי (sekvîy, sek-vee'): observant, i.e. (concretely) the mind. Origin: from the same as H7906 (שֵׂכוּ); KJV: heart.

H7908 שְׁכוֹל (shᵉkôwl, shek-ole'): bereavement. Origin: infinitive of H7921 (שָׁכֹל); KJV: loss of children, spoiling.

H7909 שַׁכּוּל (shakkûwl, shak-kool'): bereaved. Origin: or שַׁכֻּל; from H7921 (שָׁכֹל); KJV: barren, bereaved (robbed) of children (whelps).

H7910 שִׁכּוֹר (shikkôwr, shik-kore'): intoxicated, as astate or a habit. Origin: or שִׁכֹּר; from H7937 (שָׁכַר); KJV: drunk(-ard, -en, -en man).

H7911 שָׁכַח (shâkach, shaw-kakh'): to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention. Origin: or שָׁכֵחַ; a primitive root; KJV: [idiom] at all, (cause to) forget.

H7912 שְׁכַח (shᵉkach, shek-akh'): to discover (literally or figuratively). Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7911 (שָׁכַח) through the idea of disclosure of a covered or forgotten thing; KJV: find.

H7913 שָׁכֵחַ (shâkêach, shaw-kay'-akh): oblivious. Origin: from H7911 (שָׁכַח); KJV: forget.

H7914 שְׂכִיָּה (sᵉkîyâh, sek-ee-yaw'): a conspicuous object. Origin: feminine from the same as H7906 (שֵׂכוּ); KJV: picture.

H7915 שַׂכִּין (sakkîyn, sak-keen'): a knife (as pointed or edged). Origin: intensive perhaps from the same as H7906 (שֵׂכוּ) in the sense of H7753 (שׂוּךְ); KJV: knife.

H7916 שָׂכִיר (sâkîyr, saw-keer'): a man at wages by the day or year. Origin: from H7936 (שָׂכַר); KJV: hired (man, servant), hireling.

H7917 שְׂכִירָה (sᵉkîyrâh, sek-ee-raw'): a hiring. Origin: feminine of H7916 (שָׂכִיר); KJV: that is hired.

H7918 שָׁכַךְ (shâkak, shaw-kak'): to weave (i.e. lay) a trap; figuratively, (through the idea of secreting) to allay (passions; physically, abate a flood). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: appease, assuage, make to cease, pacify, set.

H7919 שָׂכַל (sâkal, saw-kal'): to be (causatively, make or act) circumspect and hence, intelligent. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: consider, expert, instruct, prosper, (deal) prudent(-ly), (give) skill(-ful), have good success, teach, (have, make to) understand(-ing), wisdom, (be, behave self, consider, make) wise(-ly), guide wittingly.

H7920 שְׂכַל (sᵉkal, sek-al'): {to be (causatively, make or act) circumspect and hence, intelligent}. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7919 (שָׂכַל) KJV: consider.

title: Strong's Hebrew Dictionary, H7921 to H8034
source: James Strong, A Concise Dictionary of the Words in the Hebrew Bible (1894), public domain; JSON edition by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA). Each entry: Strong number, Hebrew word, Latin reading, meaning, origin, how the KJV renders it.
body:
H7921 שָׁכֹל (shâkôl, shaw-kole'): properly, to miscarry, i.e. suffer abortion; by analogy, to bereave (literally or figuratively). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: bereave (of children), barren, cast calf (fruit, young), be (make) childless, deprive, destroy, [idiom] expect, lose children, miscarry, rob of children, spoil.

H7922 שֶׂכֶל (sekel, seh'-kel): intelligence; by implication, success. Origin: or שֵׂכֶל; from H7919 (שָׂכַל); KJV: discretion, knowledge, policy, prudence, sense, understanding, wisdom, wise.

H7923 שִׁכֻּלִים (shikkulîym, shik-koo-leem'): childlessness (by continued bereavements). Origin: plural from H7921 (שָׁכֹל); KJV: to have after loss of others.

H7924 שׇׂכְלְתָנוּ (soklᵉthânûw, sok-leth-aw-noo'): intelligence. Origin: (Aramaic) from H7920 (שְׂכַל); KJV: understanding.

H7925 שָׁכַם (shâkam, shaw-kam'): literally, to load up (on the back of man or beast), i.e. to start early in the morning. Origin: a primitive root; properly, to incline (the shoulder to a burden); but used only as denominative from H7926 (שְׁכֶם); KJV: (arise, be up, get (oneself) up, rise up) early (betimes), morning.

H7926 שְׁכֶם (shᵉkem, shek-em'): the neck (between the shoulders) as the place of burdens; figuratively, the spur of ahill. Origin: from H7925 (שָׁכַם); KJV: back, [idiom] consent, portion, shoulder.

H7927 שְׁכֶם (Shᵉkem, shek-em'): Shekem, a place in Palestine. Origin: the same as H7926 (שְׁכֶם); ridge; KJV: Shechem.

H7928 שֶׁכֶם (Shekem, sheh'-kem): Shekem, the name of a Hivite and two Israelites. Origin: for H7926 (שְׁכֶם); KJV: Shechem.

H7929 שִׁכְמָה (shikmâh, shik-maw'): the shoulderbone. Origin: feminine of H7926 (שְׁכֶם); KJV: shoulder blade.

H7930 שִׁכְמִי (Shikmîy, shik-mee'): a Shikmite (collectively), or descendants of Shekem. Origin: patronymic from H7928 (שֶׁכֶם); KJV: Shichemites.

H7931 שָׁכַן (shâkan, shaw-kan'): to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively). Origin: a primitive root (apparently akin (by transmission) to H7901 (שָׁכַב) through the idea of lodging; compare H5531 (סִכְלוּת), H7925 (שָׁכַם)); KJV: abide, continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-er), have habitation, inhabit, lay, place, (cause to) remain, rest, set (up).

H7932 שְׁכַן (shᵉkan, shek-an'): {to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively)}. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7931 (שָׁכַן) KJV: cause to dwell, have habitation.

H7933 שֶׁכֶן (sheken, sheh'-ken): a residence. Origin: from H7931 (שָׁכַן); KJV: habitation.

H7934 שָׁכֵן (shâkên, shaw-kane'): a resident; by extension, a fellow-citizen. Origin: from H7931 (שָׁכַן); KJV: inhabitant, neighbour, nigh.

H7935 שְׁכַנְיָה (Shᵉkanyâh, shek-an-yaw'): Shekanjah, the name of nine Israelites. Origin: or (prolonged) שְׁכַנְיָהוּ; from H7931 (שָׁכַן) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has dwelt; KJV: Shecaniah, Shechaniah.

H7936 שָׂכַר (sâkar, saw-kar'): to hire. Origin: or (by permutation) סָכַר; (Ezra 4:5), a primitive root (apparently akin (by prosthesis) to H3739 (כָּרָה) through the idea of temporary purchase; compare H7937 (שָׁכַר)); KJV: earn wages, hire (out self), reward, [idiom] surely.

H7937 שָׁכַר (shâkar, shaw-kar'): to become tipsy; in a qualified sense, to satiate with astimulating drink or (figuratively) influence. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (be filled with) drink (abundantly), (be, make) drunk(-en), be merry. (Superlative of H8248 (שָׁקָה).)

H7938 שֶׂכֶר (seker, seh'-ker): wages. Origin: from H7936 (שָׂכַר); KJV: reward, sluices.

H7939 שָׂכָר (sâkâr, saw-kawr'): payment of contract; concretely, salary, fare, maintenance; by implication, compensation, benefit. Origin: from H7936 (שָׂכַר); KJV: hire, price, reward(-ed), wages, worth.

H7940 שָׂכָר (Sâkâr, saw-kar'): Sakar, the name of two Israelites. Origin: the same as H7939 (שָׂכָר); recompense; KJV: Sacar.

H7941 שֵׁכָר (shêkâr, shay-kawr'): an intoxicant, i.e. intensely alcoholic liquor. Origin: from H7937 (שָׁכַר); KJV: strong drink, [phrase] drunkard, strong wine.

H7942 שִׁכְּרוֹן (Shikkᵉrôwn, shik-ker-one'): drunkenness, Shikkeron, a place in Palestine. Origin: for H7943 (שִׁכָּרוֹן); KJV: Shicron.

H7943 שִׁכָּרוֹן (shikkârôwn, shik-kaw-rone'): intoxication. Origin: from H7937 (שָׁכַר); KJV: (be) drunken(-ness).

H7944 שַׁל (shal, shal): a fault. Origin: from H7952 (שָׁלָה) abbreviated form; KJV: error.

H7945 שֶׁל (shel, shel): on account of, whatsoever, whichsoever. Origin: for the rel. H834 (אֲשֶׁר); used with prepositional prefix, and often followed by some pronominal affix; KJV: cause, sake.

H7946 שַׁלְאֲנָן (shalʼănân, shal-an-awn'): tranquil. Origin: for H7600 (שַׁאֲנָן); KJV: being at ease.

H7947 שָׁלַב (shâlab, shaw-lab'): to space off; intensive (evenly) to make equidistant. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: equally distant, set in order.

H7948 שָׁלָב (shâlâb, shaw-lawb'): a spacer or raised interval, i.e. the stile in aframe or panel. Origin: from H7947 (שָׁלַב); KJV: ledge.

H7949 שָׁלַג (shâlag, shaw-lag'): to be snow-white (with the linen clothing of the slain). Origin: a primitive root; properly, meaning to be white; used only as denominative from H7950 (שֶׁלֶג); KJV: be as snow.

H7950 שֶׁלֶג (sheleg, sheh'-leg): snow (probably from its whiteness). Origin: from H7949 (שָׁלַג); KJV: snow(-y).

H7951 שָׁלָה (shâlâh, shaw-law'): to be tranquil, i.e. secure or successful. Origin: or שָׁלַו; (Job 3:26), a primitive root; KJV: be happy, prosper, be in safety.

H7952 שָׁלָה (shâlâh, shaw-law'): to mislead. Origin: a primitive root (probably identical with H7953 (שָׁלָה) through the idea of educing); KJV: deceive, be negligent.

H7953 שָׁלָה (shâlâh, shaw-law'): to draw out or off, i.e. remove (the soul by death). Origin: a primitive root (rather cognate (by contraction) to the base of H5394 (נָשַׁל), H7997 (שָׁלַל) and their congeners through the idea of extracting); KJV: take away.

H7954 שְׁלָה (shᵉlâh, shel-aw'): to be secure. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7951 (שָׁלָה); KJV: at rest.

H7955 שָׁלָה (shâlâh, shaw-law'): a wrong. Origin: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H7952 (שָׁלָה); KJV: thing amiss.

H7956 שֵׁלָה (Shêlâh, shay-law'): Shelah, the name of a postdiluvian patriarch and of an Israelite. Origin: the same as H7596 (שְׁאֵלָה) (shortened); request; KJV: Shelah.

H7957 שַׁלְהֶבֶת (shalhebeth, shal-heh'-beth): a flare of fire. Origin: from the same as H3851 (לַהַב) with sibilant prefix; KJV: (flaming) flame.

H7958 שְׂלָו (sᵉlâv, sel-awv'): the quail collectively (as slow in flight from its weight). Origin: or שְׂלָיו; by orthographical variation from H7951 (שָׁלָה) through the idea of sluggishness; KJV: quails.

H7959 שֶׁלֶו (shelev, sheh'-lev): security. Origin: from H7951 (שָׁלָה); KJV: prosperity.

H7960 שָׁלוּ (shâlûw, shaw-loo'): a fault. Origin: (Aramaic) or שָׁלוּת; (Aramaic), from the same as H7955 (שָׁלָה); KJV: error, [idiom] fail, thing amiss.

H7961 שָׁלֵו (shâlêv, shaw-lave'): tranquil; (in a bad sense) careless; abstractly, security. Origin: or שָׁלֵיו; feminine שְׁלֵוָה; from H7951 (שָׁלָה); KJV: (being) at ease, peaceable, (in) prosper(-ity), quiet(-ness), wealthy.

H7962 שַׁלְוָה (shalvâh, shal-vaw'): security (genuine or false). Origin: from H7951 (שָׁלָה); KJV: abundance, peace(-ably), prosperity, quietness.

H7963 שְׁלֵוָה (shᵉlêvâh, shel-ay-vaw'): safety. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7962 (שַׁלְוָה); KJV: tranquillity. See also H7961 (שָׁלֵו).

H7964 שִׁלּוּחַ (shillûwach, shil-loo'-akh): (only in plural) a dismissal, i.e. (of a wife) divorce (especially the document); also (of a daughter) dower. Origin: or שִׁלֻּחַ; from H7971 (שָׁלַח); KJV: presents, have sent back.

H7965 שָׁלוֹם (shâlôwm, shaw-lome'): safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace. Origin: or שָׁלֹם; from H7999 (שָׁלַם); KJV: [idiom] do, familiar, [idiom] fare, favour, [phrase] friend, [idiom] great, (good) health, ([idiom] perfect, such as be at) peace(-able, -ably), prosper(-ity, -ous), rest, safe(-ty), salute, welfare, ([idiom] all is, be) well, [idiom] wholly.

H7966 שִׁלּוּם (shillûwm, shil-loom'): a requital, i.e. (secure) retribution, (venal) a fee. Origin: or שִׁלֻּם; from H7999 (שָׁלַם); KJV: recompense, reward.

H7967 שַׁלּוּם (Shallûwm, shal-loom'): Shallum, the name of fourteen Israelites. Origin: or (shorter) שַׁלֻּם; the same as H7966 (שִׁלּוּם); KJV: Shallum.

H7968 שַׁלּוּן (Shallûwn, shal-loon'): Shallun, an Israelite. Origin: probably for H7967 (שַׁלּוּם); KJV: Shallum.

H7969 שָׁלוֹשׁ (shâlôwsh, shaw-loshe'): three; occasionally (ordinal) third, or (multiple) thrice. Origin: or שָׁלֹשׁ; masculine שְׁלוֹשָׁה; or שְׁלֹשָׁה; a primitive number; KJV: [phrase] fork, [phrase] often(-times), third, thir(-teen, -teenth), three, [phrase] thrice. Compare H7991 (שָׁלִישׁ).

H7970 שְׁלוֹשִׁים (shᵉlôwshîym, shel-o-sheem'): thirty; or (ordinal) thirtieth. Origin: or שְׁלֹשִׁים; multiple of H7969 (שָׁלוֹשׁ); KJV: thirty, thirtieth. Compare H7991 (שָׁלִישׁ).

H7971 שָׁלַח (shâlach, shaw-lakh'): to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, [idiom] earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).

H7972 שְׁלַח (shᵉlach, shel-akh'): {to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)}. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7971 (שָׁלַח) KJV: put, send.

H7973 שֶׁלַח (shelach, sheh'-lakh): a missile of attack, i.e. spear; also (figuratively) a shoot of growth; i.e. branch. Origin: from H7971 (שָׁלַח); KJV: dart, plant, [idiom] put off, sword, weapon.

H7974 שֶׁלַח (Shelach, sheh'-lakh): Shelach, a postdiluvian patriarch. Origin: the same as H7973 (שֶׁלַח); KJV: Salah, Shelah. Compare H7975 (שִׁלֹחַ)lemma שִׁלֹּחַ extra dagesh, corrected to שִׁלֹחַ.

H7975 שִׁלֹחַ (Shilôach, shee-lo'-akh): Shiloach, a fountain of Jerusalem. Origin: or (in imitation of H7974 (שֶׁלַח)) שֶׁלַח; (Nehemiah 3:15), from H7971 (שָׁלַח); rill; KJV: Shiloah, Siloah.

H7976 שִׁלֻּחָה (shilluchâh, shil-loo-khaw'): a shoot. Origin: feminine of H7964 (שִׁלּוּחַ); KJV: branch.

H7977 שִׁלְחִי (Shilchîy, shil-khee'): Shilchi, an Israelite. Origin: from H7973 (שֶׁלַח); missive, i.e. armed; KJV: Shilhi.

H7978 שִׁלְחִים (Shilchîym, shil-kheem'): Shilchim, a place in Palestine. Origin: plural of H7973 (שֶׁלַח); javelins or sprouts; KJV: Shilhim.

H7979 שֻׁלְחָן (shulchân, shool-khawn'): a table (as spread out); by implication, a meal. Origin: from H7971 (שָׁלַח); KJV: table.

H7980 שָׁלַט (shâlaṭ, shaw-lat'): to dominate, i.e. govern; by implication, to permit. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (bear, have) rule, have dominion, give (have) power.

H7981 שְׁלֵט (shᵉlêṭ, shel-ate'): {to dominate, i.e. govern; by implication, to permit}. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7980 (שָׁלַט) KJV: have the mastery, have power, bear rule, be (make) ruler.

H7982 שֶׁלֶט (sheleṭ, sheh'-let): probably a shield (as controlling, i.e. protecting the person). Origin: from H7980 (שָׁלַט); KJV: shield.

H7983 שִׁלְטוֹן (shilṭôwn, shil-tone'): {power.}. Origin: (Aramaic) from H7980 (שָׁלַט); KJV: power.

H7984 שִׁלְטוֹן (shilṭôwn, shil-tone'): {a potentate}. Origin: (Aramaic) or שִׁלְטֹןlemma שִׁלְטן missing vowel, corrected to שִׁלְטֹן; corresponding to H7983 (שִׁלְטוֹן) KJV: ruler.

H7985 שׇׁלְטָן (sholṭân, shol-tawn'): empire (abstractly or concretely). Origin: (Aramaic) from H7981 (שְׁלֵט); KJV: dominion.

H7986 שַׁלֶּטֶת (shalleṭeth, shal-leh'-teth): a vixen. Origin: feminine from H7980 (שָׁלַט); KJV: imperious.

H7987 שְׁלִי (shᵉlîy, shel-ee'): privacy. Origin: from H7951 (שָׁלָה); KJV: [phrase] quietly.

H7988 שִׁלְיָה (shilyâh, shil-yaw'): a fetus or babe (as extruded in birth). Origin: feminine from H7953 (שָׁלָה); KJV: young one.

H7989 שַׁלִּיט (shallîyṭ, shal-leet'): potent; concretely, a prince or warrior. Origin: from H7980 (שָׁלַט); KJV: governor, mighty, that hath power, ruler.

H7990 שַׁלִּיט (shallîyṭ, shal-leet'): mighty; abstractly, permission; concretely, a premier. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7989 (שַׁלִּיט); KJV: captain, be lawful, rule(-r).

H7991 שָׁלִישׁ (shâlîysh, shaw-leesh'): a triple, i.e. (as a musical instrument) a triangle (or perhaps rather threestringed lute); also (as an indefinite, great quantity) a three-fold measure (perhaps a treble ephah); also (as an officer) a general of the third rank (upward, i.e. the highest). Origin: or שָׁלוֹשׁ; (1 Chronicles 11:11; 1 Chronicles 12:18), or שָׁלֹשׁ; (2 Samuel 23:13), from H7969 (שָׁלוֹשׁ); KJV: captain, instrument of musick, (great) lord, (great) measure, prince, three (from the margin).

H7992 שְׁלִישִׁי (shᵉlîyshîy, shel-ee-shee'): third; feminine athird (part); by extension, a third (day, year or time); specifically, a third-story cell). Origin: ordinal from H7969 (שָׁלוֹשׁ); KJV: third (part, rank, time), three (years old).

H7993 שָׁלַךְ (shâlak, shaw-lak): to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: adventure, cast (away, down, forth, off, out), hurl, pluck, throw.

H7994 שָׁלָךְ (shâlâk, shaw-lawk'): bird of prey, usually thought to be the pelican (from casting itself into the sea). Origin: from H7993 (שָׁלַךְ); KJV: cormorant.

H7995 שַׁלֶּכֶת (shalleketh, shal-leh'-keth): a felling (of trees). Origin: from H7993 (שָׁלַךְ); KJV: when cast.

H7996 שַׁלֶּכֶת (Shalleketh, shal-leh'-keth): Shalleketh, a gate in Jerusalem. Origin: the same as H7995 (שַׁלֶּכֶת); KJV: Shalleketh.

H7997 שָׁלַל (shâlal, shaw-lal'): to drop or strip; by implication, to plunder. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: let fall, make self a prey, [idiom] of purpose, (make a, (take)) spoil.

H7998 שָׁלָל (shâlâl, shaw-lawl'): booty. Origin: from H7997 (שָׁלַל); KJV: prey, spoil.

H7999 שָׁלַם (shâlam, shaw-lam'): to be safe (in mind, body or estate); figuratively, to be (causatively, make) completed; by implication, to be friendly; by extension, to reciprocate (in various applications). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: make amends, (make an) end, finish, full, give again, make good, (re-) pay (again), (make) (to) (be at) peace(-able), that is perfect, perform, (make) prosper(-ous), recompense, render, requite, make restitution, restore, reward, [idiom] surely.

H8000 שְׁלַם (shᵉlam, shel-am'): to complete, to restore. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7999 (שָׁלַם); KJV: deliver, finish.

H8001 שְׁלָם (shᵉlâm, shel-awm'): prosperity. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7965 (שָׁלוֹם); KJV: peace.

H8002 שֶׁלֶם (shelem, sheh'-lem): properly, requital, i.e. a (voluntary) sacrifice in thanks. Origin: from H7999 (שָׁלַם); KJV: peace offering.

H8003 שָׁלֵם (shâlêm, shaw-lame'): complete (literally or figuratively); especially friendly. Origin: from H7999 (שָׁלַם); KJV: full, just, made ready, peaceable, perfect(-ed), quiet, Shalem (by mistake for a name), whole.

H8004 שָׁלֵם (Shâlêm, shaw-lame'): Shalem, an early name of Jerusalem. Origin: the same as H8003 (שָׁלֵם); peaceful; KJV: Salem.

H8005 שִׁלֵּם (shillêm, shil-lame'): requital. Origin: from H7999 (שָׁלַם); KJV: recompense.

H8006 שִׁלֵּם (Shillêm, shil-lame'): Shillem, an Israelite. Origin: the same as H8005 (שִׁלֵּם); KJV: Shillem.

H8007 שַׂלְמָא (Salmâʼ, sal-maw'): Salma, the name of two Israelites. Origin: probably for H8008 (שַׂלְמָה); clothing; KJV: Salma.

H8008 שַׂלְמָה (salmâh, sal-maw'): a dress. Origin: transp. for H8071 (שִׂמְלָה); KJV: clothes, garment, raiment.

H8009 שַׂלְמָה (Salmâh, sal-maw'): Salmah, an Israelite. Origin: the same as H8008 (שַׂלְמָה); clothing; KJV: Salmon. Compare H8012 (שַׂלְמוֹן).
