H8507 תֹּכֶן (Tôken, to'-ken): Token, a place in Palestine. Origin: the same as H8506 (תֹּכֶן); KJV: Tochen.

H8508 תׇּכְנִית (toknîyth, tok-neeth'): admeasurement, i.e. consummation. Origin: from H8506 (תֹּכֶן); KJV: pattern, sum.

H8509 תַּכְרִיךְ (takrîyk, tak-reek'): a wrapper or robe. Origin: apparently from an unused root meaning to encompass; KJV: garment.

H8510 תֵּל (têl, tale): a mound. Origin: by contraction from H8524 (תָּלַל); KJV: heap, [idiom] strength.

H8511 תָּלָא (tâlâʼ, taw-law'): to suspend; figuratively (through hesitation) to be uncertain; by implication (of mental dependence) to habituate. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: be bent, hang (in doubt).

H8512 תֵּל אָבִיב (Têl ʼÂbîyb, tale aw-beeb'): Tel-Abib, a place in Chaldaea. Origin: from H8510 (תֵּל) and H24 (אָבִיב); mound of green growth; KJV: Tel-abib.

H8513 תְּלָאָה (tᵉlâʼâh, tel-aw-aw'): distress. Origin: from H3811 (לָאָה); KJV: travail, travel, trouble.

H8514 תַּלְאוּבָה (talʼûwbâh, tal-oo-baw'): desiccation. Origin: from H3851 (לַהַב); KJV: great drought.

H8515 תְּלַאשַּׂר (Tᵉlaʼssar, tel-as-sar'): Telassar, a region of Assyria. Origin: or תְּלַשַּׂר; of foreign derivation; KJV: Telassar.

H8516 תַּלְבֹּשֶׁת (talbôsheth, tal-bo'-sheth): a garment. Origin: from H3847 (לָבַשׁ); KJV: clothing.

H8517 תְּלַג (tᵉlag, tel-ag'): snow. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H7950 (שֶׁלֶג); KJV: snow.

H8518 תָּלָה (tâlâh, taw-law'): to suspend (especially to gibbet). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: hang (up).

H8519 תְּלוּנָה (tᵉlûwnâh, tel-oo-naw'): a grumbling. Origin: or תּלֻנָּה; from H3885 (לוּן) in the sense of obstinacy; KJV: murmuring.

H8520 תֶּלַח (Telach, teh'-lakh): Telach, an Israelite. Origin: probably from an unused root meaning to dissever; breach; KJV: Telah.

H8521 תֵּל חַרְשָׁא (Têl Charshâʼ, tale khar-shaw'): Tel-Charsha, a place in Babylonia. Origin: from H8510 (תֵּל) and the feminine of H2798 (חֲרָשִׁים); mound of workmanship; KJV: Tel-haresha, Tel-harsa.

H8522 תְּלִי (tᵉlîy, tel-ee'): a quiver (as slung). Origin: probably from H8518 (תָּלָה); KJV: quiver.

H8523 תְּלִיתַי (tᵉlîythay, tel-ee-thah'-ee): third. Origin: (Aramaic) or תַּלְתִּי; (Aramaic), ordinal from H8532 (תְּלָת); KJV: third.

H8524 תָּלַל (tâlal, taw-lal'): to pile up, i.e. elevate. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: eminent. Compare H2048 (הָתַל).

H8525 תֶּלֶם (telem, teh'-lem): a bank or terrace. Origin: from an unused root meaning to accumulate; KJV: furrow, ridge.

H8526 תַּלְמַי (Talmay, tal-mah'-ee): Talmai, the name of a Canaanite and a Syrian. Origin: from H8525 (תֶּלֶם); ridged; KJV: Talmai.

H8527 תַּלְמִיד (talmîyd, tal-meed'): a pupil. Origin: from H3925 (לָמַד); KJV: scholar.

H8528 תֵּל מֶלַח (Têl Melach, tale meh'-lakh): Tel-Melach, a place in Babylonia. Origin: from H8510 (תֵּל) and H4417 (מֶלַח); mound of salt; KJV: Tel-melah.

H8529 תָּלַע (tâlaʻ, taw-law'): to crimson, i.e. dye that color. Origin: a denominative from H8438 (תּוֹלָע); KJV: [idiom] scarlet.

H8530 תַּלְפִּיָּה (talpîyâh, tal-pee-yaw'): something tall, i.e. (plural collective) slenderness. Origin: feminine from an unused root meaning to tower; KJV: armoury.

H8531 תְּלַת (tᵉlath, tel-ath'): a tertiary rank. Origin: (Aramaic) from H8532 (תְּלָת); KJV: third.

H8532 תְּלָת (tᵉlâth, tel-awth'): three or third. Origin: (Aramaic) masculine תְּלָתָה; (Aramaic), or תְּלָתָא; (Aramaic), corresponding to H7969 (שָׁלוֹשׁ); KJV: third, three.

H8533 תְּלָתִין (tᵉlâthîyn, tel-aw-theen'): ten times three. Origin: (Aramaic) multiple of H8532 (תְּלָת); KJV: thirty.

H8534 תַּלְתַּל (taltal, tal-tal'): a trailing bough (as pendulous). Origin: by reduplication, from H8524 (תָּלַל) through the idea of vibration; KJV: bushy.

H8535 תָּם (tâm, tawm): complete; usually (morally) pious; specifically, gentle, dear. Origin: from H8552 (תָּמַם); KJV: coupled together, perfect, plain, undefiled, upright.

H8536 תָּם (tâm, tawm): there. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8033 (שָׁם); KJV: [idiom] thence, there, [idiom] where.

H8537 תֹּם (tôm, tome): completeness; figuratively, prosperity; usually (morally) innocence. Origin: from H8552 (תָּמַם); KJV: full, integrity, perfect(-ion), simplicity, upright(-ly, -ness), at a venture. See H8550 (תֻּמִּים).

H8538 תֻּמָּה (tummâh, toom-maw'): innocence. Origin: feminine of H8537 (תֹּם); KJV: integrity.

H8539 תָּמַהּ (tâmahh, taw-mah'): to be in consternation. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: be amazed, be astonished, marvel(-lously), wonder.

H8540 תְּמַהּ (tᵉmahh, tem-ah'): a miracle. Origin: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H8539 (תָּמַהּ); KJV: wonder.

H8541 תִּמָּהוֹן (timmâhôwn, tim-maw-hone'): consternation. Origin: from H8539 (תָּמַהּ); KJV: astonishment.

H8542 תַּמּוּז (Tammûwz, tam-mooz'): Tammuz, a Phoenician deity. Origin: of uncertain derivation; KJV: Tammuz.

H8543 תְּמוֹל (tᵉmôwl, tem-ole'): properly, ago, i.e. a (short or long) time since; especially yesterday, or day before yesterday. Origin: or תְּמֹל; probably for H865 (אֶתְמוֹל); sometimes with H8032 (שִׁלְשׁוֹם) KJV: [phrase] before (-time), [phrase] these (three) days, [phrase] heretofore, [phrase] time past, yesterday.

title: Strong's Hebrew Dictionary, H8544 to H8671
source: James Strong, A Concise Dictionary of the Words in the Hebrew Bible (1894), public domain; JSON edition by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA). Each entry: Strong number, Hebrew word, Latin reading, meaning, origin, how the KJV renders it.
body:
H8544 תְּמוּנָה (tᵉmûwnâh, tem-oo-naw'): something portioned (i.e. fashioned) out, as ashape, i.e. (indefinitely) phantom, or (specifically) embodiment, or (figuratively) manifestation (of favor). Origin: or תְּמֻנָה; from H4327 (מִין); KJV: image, likeness, similitude.

H8545 תְּמוּרָה (tᵉmûwrâh, tem-oo-raw'): barter, compensation. Origin: from H4171 (מוּר); KJV: (ex-) change(-ing), recompense, restitution.

H8546 תְּמוּתָה (tᵉmûwthâh, tem-oo-thaw'): execution (as a doom). Origin: from H4191 (מוּת); KJV: death, die.

H8547 תֶּמַח (Temach, teh'-makh): Temach, one of the Nethinim. Origin: of uncertain derivation; KJV: Tamah, Thamah.

H8548 תָּמִיד (tâmîyd, taw-meed'): properly, continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially, constantly); ellipt. the regular (daily) sacrifice. Origin: from an unused root meaning to stretch; KJV: alway(-s), continual (employment, -ly), daily, (n-)ever(-more), perpetual.

H8549 תָּמִים (tâmîym, taw-meem'): entire (literally, figuratively or morally); also (as noun) integrity, truth. Origin: from H8552 (תָּמַם); KJV: without blemish, complete, full, perfect, sincerely (-ity), sound, without spot, undefiled, upright(-ly), whole.

H8550 תֻּמִּים (Tummîym, toom-meem'): perfections, i.e. (techn.) one of the epithets of the objects in the high-priest's breastplate as an emblem of complete Truth. Origin: plural of H8537 (תֹּם); KJV: Thummim.

H8551 תָּמַךְ (tâmak, taw-mak'): to sustain; by implication, to obtain, keep fast; figuratively, to help, follow close. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (take, up-) hold (up), maintain, retain, stay (up).

H8552 תָּמַם (tâmam, taw-mam'): to complete, in a good or a bad sense, literal, or figurative, transitive or intransitive. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: accomplish, cease, be clean (pass-) ed, consume, have done, (come to an, have an, make an) end, fail, come to the full, be all gone, [idiom] be all here, be (make) perfect, be spent, sum, be (shew self) upright, be wasted, whole.

H8553 תִּמְנָה (Timnâh, tim-naw'): Timnah, the name of two places in Palestine. Origin: from H4487 (מָנָה); a portion assigned; KJV: Timnah, Timnath, Thimnathah.

H8554 תִּמְנִי (Timnîy, tim-nee'): a Timnite or inhabitant of Timnah. Origin: patrial from H8553 (תִּמְנָה); KJV: Timnite.

H8555 תִּמְנָע (Timnâʻ, tim-naw'): Timna, the name of two Edomites. Origin: from H4513 (מָנַע); restraint; KJV: Timna, Timnah.

H8556 תִּמְנַת חֶרֶס (Timnath Chereç, tim-nath kheh'-res): Timnath-Cheres, a place in Palestine. Origin: or תִּמְנַת סֶרַח; from H8553 (תִּמְנָה) and H2775 (חֶרֶס); portion of (the) sun; KJV: Timnath-heres, Timnath-serah.

H8557 תֶּמֶס (temeç, teh'-mes): liquefaction, i.e. disappearance. Origin: from H4529 (מָסָה); KJV: melt.

H8558 תָּמָר (tâmâr, taw-mawr'): a palm tree. Origin: from an unused root meaning to be erect; KJV: palm (tree).

H8559 תָּמָר (Tâmâr, taw-mawr'): Tamar, the name of three women and a place. Origin: the same as H8558 (תָּמָר); KJV: Tamar.

H8560 תֹּמֶר (tômer, to'-mer): a palm trunk. Origin: from the same root as H8558 (תָּמָר); KJV: palm tree.

H8561 תִּמֹּר (timmôr, tim-more'): (architectural) a palm-like pilaster (i.e. umbellate). Origin: (plural or (feminine) תִּמֹּרָה; (singular and plural), from the same root as H8558 (תָּמָר); KJV: palm tree.

H8562 תַּמְרוּק (tamrûwq, tam-rook'): properly, a scouring, i.e. soap or perfumery forthe bath; figuratively, a detergent. Origin: or תַּמְרֻק; or תַּמְרִיק; from H4838 (מָרַק); KJV: [idiom] cleanse, (thing for) purification(-fying).

H8563 תַּמְרוּר (tamrûwr, tam-roor'): bitterness (plural as collective). Origin: from H4843 (מָרַר); KJV: [idiom] most bitter(-ly).

H8564 תַּמְרוּר (tamrûwr, tam-roor'): an erection, i.e. pillar (probably for a guide-board). Origin: from the same root as H8558 (תָּמָר); KJV: high heap.

H8565 תַּן (tan, tan): a monster (as preternaturally formed), i.e. a sea-serpent (or other huge marine animal); also a jackal (or other hideous land animal). Origin: from an unused root probably meaning to elongate; KJV: dragon, whale. Compare H8577 (תַּנִּין).

H8566 תָּנָה (tânâh, taw-naw'): to present (a mercenary inducement), i.e. bargain with (a harlot). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: hire.

H8567 תָּנָה (tânâh, taw-naw'): to ascribe (praise), i.e. celebrate, commemorate. Origin: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of attributing honor); KJV: lament, rehearse.

H8568 תַּנָּה (tannâh, tan-naw'): a female jackal. Origin: probably feminine of H8565 (תַּן); KJV: dragon.

H8569 תְּנוּאָה (tᵉnûwʼâh, ten-oo-aw'): alienation; by implication, enmity. Origin: from H5106 (נוּא); KJV: breach of promise, occasion.

H8570 תְּנוּבָה (tᵉnûwbâh, ten-oo-baw'): produce. Origin: from H5107 (נוּב); KJV: fruit, increase.

H8571 תְּנוּךְ (tᵉnûwk, ten-ook'): a pinnacle, i.e. extremity. Origin: perhaps from the same as H594 (אֲנָךְ) through the idea of protraction; KJV: tip.

H8572 תְּנוּמָה (tᵉnûwmâh, ten-oo-maw'): drowsiness, i.e. sleep. Origin: from H5123 (נוּם); KJV: slumber(-ing).

H8573 תְּנוּפָה (tᵉnûwphâh, ten-oo-faw'): a brandishing (in threat); by implication, tumult; specifically, the official undulation of sacrificial offerings. Origin: from H5130 (נוּף); KJV: offering, shaking, wave (offering).

H8574 תַּנּוּר (tannûwr, tan-noor'): a fire-pot. Origin: from H5216 (נִיר); KJV: furnace, oven.

H8575 תַּנְחוּם (tanchûwm, tan-khoom'): compassion, solace. Origin: or תַּנְחֻם; and (feminine) תַּנְחוּמָה; from H5162 (נָחַם); KJV: comfort, consolation.

H8576 תַּנְחֻמֶת (Tanchumeth, tan-khoo'-meth): Tanchumeth, an Israelite. Origin: for H8575 (תַּנְחוּם) (feminine); KJV: Tanhumeth.

H8577 תַּנִּין (tannîyn, tan-neen'): a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal. Origin: or תַּנִּים; (Ezekiel 29:3), intensive from the same as H8565 (תַּן); KJV: dragon, sea-monster, serpent, whale.

H8578 תִּנְיָן (tinyân, tin-yawn'): second. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8147 (שְׁנַיִם); KJV: second.

H8579 תִּנְיָנוּת (tinyânûwth, tin-yaw-nooth'): a second time. Origin: (Aramaic) from H8578 (תִּנְיָן); KJV: again.

H8580 תַּנְשֶׁמֶת (tanshemeth, tan-sheh'-meth): properly, a hard breather, i.e. the name of two unclean creatures, a lizard and abird (both perhaps from changing color through their irascibility), probably the tree-toad and the water-hen. Origin: from H5395 (נָשַׁם); KJV: mole, swan.

H8581 תַּעָב (taʻâb, taw-ab'): to loathe, i.e. (morally) detest. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (make to be) abhor(-red), (be, commit more, do) abominable(-y), [idiom] utterly.

H8582 תָּעָה (tâʻâh, taw-aw'): to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray (literally or figuratively); also causative of both. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (cause to) go astray, deceive, dissemble, (cause to, make to) err, pant, seduce, (make to) stagger, (cause to) wander, be out of the way.

H8583 תֹּעוּ (Tôʻûw, to'-oo): Tou or Toi, a Syrian king. Origin: or תֹּעִי; from H8582 (תָּעָה); error KJV: Toi, Tou.

H8584 תְּעוּדָה (tᵉʻûwdâh, teh-oo-daw'): attestation, i.e. a precept, usage. Origin: from H5749 (עוּד); KJV: testimony.

H8585 תְּעָלָה (tᵉʻâlâh, teh-aw-law'): a channel (into which water is raised for irrigation); also a bandage or plaster (as placed upon a wound). Origin: from H5927 (עָלָה); KJV: conduit, cured, healing, little river, trench, watercourse.

H8586 תַּעֲלוּל (taʻălûwl, tah-al-ool'): caprice (as a fit coming on), i.e. vexation; concretely a tyrant. Origin: from H5953 (עָלַל); KJV: babe, delusion.

H8587 תַּעֲלֻמָּה (taʻălummâh, tah-al-oom-maw'): a secret. Origin: from H5956 (עָלַם); KJV: thing that is hid, secret.

H8588 תַּעֲנוּג (taʻănûwg, tah-an-oog'): luxury. Origin: or תַּעֲנֻג; and (feminine) תַּעֲנֻגָה; from H6026 (עָנַג); KJV: delicate, delight, pleasant.

H8589 תַּעֲנִית (taʻănîyth, tah-an-eeth'): affliction (of self), i.e. fasting. Origin: from H6031 (עָנָה); KJV: heaviness.

H8590 תַּעֲנָךְ (Taʻănâk, tah-an-awk'): Taanak or Tanak, a place in Palestine. Origin: or תַּעְנָךְ; of uncertain derivation; KJV: Taanach, Tanach.

H8591 תָּעַע (tâʻaʻ, taw-ah'): to cheat; by analogy, to maltreat. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: deceive, misuse.

H8592 תַּעֲצֻמָה (taʻătsumâh, tah-ats-oo-maw'): might (plural collective). Origin: from H6105 (עָצַם); KJV: power.

H8593 תַּעַר (taʻar, tah'-ar): a knife or razor (as making bare); also a scabbard (as being bare, i.e. empty). Origin: from H6168 (עָרָה); KJV: (pen-) knife, razor, scabbard, shave, sheath.

H8594 תַּעֲרֻבָה (taʻărubâh, tah-ar-oo-baw'): suretyship, i.e. (concretely) a pledge. Origin: from H6148 (עָרַב); KJV: [phrase] hostage.

H8595 תַּעְתֻּעַ (taʻtuaʻ, tah-too'-ah): a fraud. Origin: from H8591 (תָּעַע); KJV: error.

H8596 תֹּף (tôph, tofe): a tambourine. Origin: from H8608 (תָּפַף) contracted; KJV: tabret, timbrel.

H8597 תִּפְאָרָה (tiphʼârâh, tif-aw-raw'): ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively). Origin: or תִּפְאֶרֶת; from H6286 (פָּאַר); KJV: beauty(-iful), bravery, comely, fair, glory(-ious), honour, majesty.

H8598 תַּפּוּחַ (tappûwach, tap-poo'-akh): an apple (from its fragrance), i.e. the fruit or the tree (probably includ. others of the pome order, as the quince, the orange, etc.). Origin: from H5301 (נָפַח); KJV: apple (tree). See also H1054 (בֵּית תַּפּוּחַ).

H8599 תַּפּוּחַ (Tappûwach, tap-poo'-akh): Tappuach, the name of two places in Palestine, also of an Israelite. Origin: the same as H8598 (תַּפּוּחַ); KJV: Tappuah.

H8600 תְּפוֹצָה (tᵉphôwtsâh, tef-o-tsaw'): a dispersal. Origin: from H6327 (פּוּץ); KJV: dispersion.

H8601 תֻּפִין (tuphîyn, too-feen'): cookery, i.e. (concretely) a cake. Origin: from H644 (אָפָה); KJV: baked piece.

H8602 תָּפֵל (tâphêl, taw-fale'): plaster (as gummy) or slime; (figuratively) frivolity. Origin: from an unused root meaning to smear; KJV: foolish things, unsavoury, untempered.

H8603 תֹּפֶל (Tôphel, to'-fel): Tophel, a place near the Desert. Origin: from the same as H8602 (תָּפֵל); quagmire; KJV: Tophel.

H8604 תִּפְלָה (tiphlâh, tif-law'): frivolity. Origin: from the same as H8602 (תָּפֵל); KJV: folly, foolishly.

H8605 תְּפִלָּה (tᵉphillâh, tef-il-law'): intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn. Origin: from H6419 (פָּלַל); KJV: prayer.

H8606 תִּפְלֶצֶת (tiphletseth, tif-leh'-tseth): fearfulness. Origin: from H6426 (פָּלַץ); KJV: terrible.

H8607 תִּפְסַח (Tiphçach, tif-sakh'): Tiphsach, a place in Mesopotamia. Origin: from H6452 (פָּסַח); ford; KJV: Tipsah.

H8608 תָּפַף (tâphaph, taw-faf'): to drum, i.e. play (as) on the tambourine. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: taber, play with timbrels.

H8609 תָּפַר (tâphar, taw-far'): to sew. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: (women that) sew (together).

H8610 תָּפַשׂ (tâphas, taw-fas'): to manipulate, i.e. seize; chiefly to capture, wield, specifically, to overlay; figuratively, to use unwarrantably. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: catch, handle, (lay, take) hold (on, over), stop, [idiom] surely, surprise, take.

H8611 תֹּפֶת (tôpheth, to'-feth): a smiting, i.e. (figuratively) contempt. Origin: from the base of H8608 (תָּפַף); KJV: tabret.

H8612 תֹּפֶת (Tôpheth, to'-feth): Topheth, a place near Jerusalem. Origin: the same as H8611 (תֹּפֶת); KJV: Tophet, Topheth.

H8613 תׇּפְתֶּה (Tophteh, tof-teh'): Tophteh, a place of cremation. Origin: probably a form of H8612 (תֹּפֶת); KJV: Tophet.

H8614 תִּפְתַּי (tiphtay, tif-tah'-ee): judicial, i.e. a lawyer. Origin: (Aramaic) perhaps from H8199 (שָׁפַט); KJV: sheriff.

H8615 תִּקְוָה (tiqvâh, tik-vaw'): literally a cord (as an attachment); figuratively, expectancy. Origin: from H6960 (קָוָה); (compare H6961 (קָוֶה)) KJV: expectation(-ted), hope, live, thing that I long for.

H8616 תִּקְוָה (Tiqvâh, tik-vaw'): Tikvah, the name of two Israelites. Origin: the same as H8615 (תִּקְוָה); KJV: Tikvah.

H8617 תְּקוּמָה (tᵉqûwmâh, tek-oo-maw'): resistfulness. Origin: from H6965 (קוּם); KJV: power to stand.

H8618 תְּקוֹמֵם (tᵉqôwmêm, tek-o-mame'): an opponent. Origin: from H6965 (קוּם); KJV: rise up against.

H8619 תָּקוֹעַ (tâqôwaʻ, taw-ko'-ah): a trumpet. Origin: from H8628 (תָּקַע) (in the musical sense); KJV: trumpet.

H8620 תְּקוֹעַ (Tᵉqôwaʻ, tek-o'-ah): Tekoa, a place in Palestine. Origin: a form of H8619 (תָּקוֹעַ); KJV: Tekoa, Tekoah.

H8621 תְּקוֹעִי (Tᵉqôwʻîy, tek-o-ee'): a Tekoite or inhabitant of Tekoah. Origin: or תְּקֹעִי; patronymically from H8620 (תְּקוֹעַ); KJV: Tekoite.

H8622 תְּקוּפָה (tᵉqûwphâh, tek-oo-faw'): a revolution, i.e. (of the sun) course, (of time) lapse. Origin: or תְּקֻפָה; from H5362 (נָקַף); KJV: circuit, come about, end.

H8623 תַּקִּיף (taqqîyph, tak-keef'): powerful. Origin: from H8630 (תָּקַף); KJV: mightier.

H8624 תַּקִּיף (taqqîyph, tak-keef'): {powerful}. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8623 (תַּקִּיף) KJV: mighty, strong.

H8625 תְּקַל (tᵉqal, tek-al'): to balance. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8254 (שָׁקַל); KJV: Tekel, be weighed.

H8626 תָּקַן (tâqan, taw-kan'): to equalize, i.e. straighten (intransitive or transitive); figuratively, to compose. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: set in order, make straight.

H8627 תְּקַן (tᵉqan, tek-an'): to straighten up, i.e. confirm. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8626 (תָּקַן); KJV: establish.

H8628 תָּקַע (tâqaʻ, taw-kah'): to clatter, i.e. slap (the hands together), clang (an instrument); by analogy, to drive (a nail or tent-pin, a dart, etc.); by implication, to become bondsman by handclasping). Origin: a primitive root; KJV: blow (a trumpet), cast, clap, fasten, pitch (tent), smite, sound, strike, [idiom] suretiship, thrust.

H8629 תֵּקַע (têqaʻ, tay-kah'): a blast of a trumpet. Origin: from H8628 (תָּקַע); KJV: sound.

H8630 תָּקַף (tâqaph, taw-kaf'): to overpower. Origin: a primitive root; KJV: prevail (against).

H8631 תְּקֵף (tᵉqêph, tek-afe'): to become (causatively, make) mighty or (figuratively) obstinate. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8630 (תָּקַף); KJV: make firm, harden, be(-come) strong.

H8632 תְּקֹף (tᵉqôph, tek-ofe'): power. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8633 (תֹּקֶף); KJV: might, strength.

H8633 תֹּקֶף (tôqeph, to'-kef): might or (figuratively) positiveness. Origin: from H8630 (תָּקַף); KJV: authority, power, strength.

H8634 תַּרְאֲלָה (Tarʼălâh, tar-al-aw'): Taralah, a place in Palestine. Origin: probably for H8653 (תַּרְעֵלָה); a reeling; KJV: Taralah.

H8635 תַּרְבּוּת (tarbûwth, tar-booth'): multiplication, i.e. progeny. Origin: from H7235 (רָבָה); KJV: increase.

H8636 תַּרְבִּית (tarbîyth, tar-beeth'): multiplication, i.e. percentage or bonus in addition to principal. Origin: from H7235 (רָבָה); KJV: increase, unjust gain.

H8637 תִּרְגַּל (tirgal, teer-gal'): to cause to walk. Origin: a denominative from H7270 (רָגַל); KJV: teach to go.

H8638 תִּרְגַּם (tirgam, teer-gam'): to transfer, i.e. translate. Origin: a denominative from H7275 (רָגַם) in the sense of throwing over; KJV: interpret.

H8639 תַּרְדֵּמָה (tardêmâh, tar-day-maw'): a lethargy or (by implication) trance. Origin: from H7290 (רָדַם); KJV: deep sleep.

H8640 תִּרְהָקָה (Tirhâqâh, teer-haw'-kaw): Tirhakah, a king of Kush. Origin: of foreign derivation; KJV: Tirhakah.

H8641 תְּרוּמָה (tᵉrûwmâh, ter-oo-maw'): a present (as offered up), especially in sacrifice or as tribute. Origin: or תְּרֻמָה; (Deuteronomy 12:11), from H7311 (רוּם); KJV: gift, heave offering (shoulder), oblation, offered(-ing).

H8642 תְּרוּמִיָּה (tᵉrûwmîyâh, ter-oo-mee-yaw'): a sacrificial offering. Origin: formed as H8641 (תְּרוּמָה); KJV: oblation.

H8643 תְּרוּעָה (tᵉrûwʻâh, ter-oo-aw'): clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry; especially clangorof trumpets, as an alarum. Origin: from H7321 (רוּעַ); KJV: alarm, blow(-ing) (of, the) (trumpets), joy, jubile, loud noise, rejoicing, shout(-ing), (high, joyful) sound(-ing).

H8644 תְּרוּפָה (tᵉrûwphâh, ter-oo-faw'): a remedy. Origin: from H7322 (רוּף) in the sense of its congener H7495 (רָפָא); KJV: medicine.

H8645 תִּרְזָה (tirzâh, teer-zaw'): a species of tree (apparently from its slenderness), perhaps the cypress. Origin: probably from H7329 (רָזָה); KJV: cypress.

H8646 תֶּרַח (Terach, teh'-rakh): Terach, the father of Abraham; also a place in the Desert. Origin: of uncertain derivation; KJV: Tarah, Terah.

H8647 תִּרְחֲנָה (Tirchănâh, teer-khan-aw'): Tirchanah, an Israelite. Origin: of uncertain derivation; KJV: Tirhanah.

H8648 תְּרֵין (tᵉrêyn, ter-ane'): two. Origin: (Aramaic) feminine תַּרְתֵּין; corresponding to H8147 (שְׁנַיִם); KJV: second, [phrase] twelve, two.

H8649 תׇּרְמָה (tormâh, tor-maw'): fraud. Origin: and תַּרְמוּת; or תַּרְמִית; from H7411 (רָמָה); KJV: deceit(-ful), privily.

H8650 תֹּרֶן (tôren, to'-ren): a pole (as a mast or flagstaff). Origin: probably for H766 (אֹרֶן); KJV: beacon, mast.

H8651 תְּרַע (tᵉraʻ, ter-ah'): a door; by implication, a palace. Origin: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8179 (שַׁעַר); KJV: gate mouth.

H8652 תָּרָע (târâʻ, taw-raw'): a doorkeeper. Origin: (Aramaic) from H8651 (תְּרַע); KJV: porter.

H8653 תַּרְעֵלָה (tarʻêlâh, tar-ay-law'): reeling. Origin: from H7477 (רָעַל); KJV: astonishment, trembling.

H8654 תִּרְעָתִי (Tirʻâthîy, teer-aw-thee'): a Tirathite or inhabitant of an unknown Tirah. Origin: patrial from an unused name meaning gate; KJV: Tirathite.

H8655 תְּרָפִים (tᵉrâphîym, ter-aw-feme'): Teraphim (singular or plural) a family idol. Origin: plural from H7495 (רָפָא); a healer; KJV: idols(-atry), images, teraphim.

H8656 תִּרְצָה (Tirtsâh, teer-tsaw'): Tirtsah, a place in Palestine; also an Israelitess. Origin: from H7521 (רָצָה); delightsomeness; KJV: Tirzah.

H8657 תֶּרֶשׁ (Teresh, teh'-resh): Teresh, a eunuch of Xerxes. Origin: of foreign derivation; KJV: Teresh.

H8658 תַּרְשִׁישׁ (tarshîysh, tar-sheesh'): a gem, perhaps the topaz. Origin: probably of foreign derivation (compare H8659 (תַּרְשִׁישׁ)); KJV: beryl.

H8659 תַּרְשִׁישׁ (Tarshîysh, tar-sheesh'): Tarshish, a place on the Mediterranean, hence, the ephithet of a merchant vessel (as if for or from that port); also the name of a Persian and of an Israelite. Origin: probably the same as H8658 (תַּרְשִׁישׁ) (as the region of the stone, or the reverse); KJV: Tarshish, Tharshish.

H8660 תִּרְשָׁתָא (Tirshâthâʼ, teer-shaw-thaw'): Tirshatha, the title of a Persian deputy or governor. Origin: of foreign derivation; KJV: Tirshatha.

H8661 תַּרְתָּן (Tartân, tar-tawn'): Tartan, an Assyrian. Origin: of foreign derivation; KJV: Tartan.

H8662 תַּרְתָּק (Tartâq, tar-tawk'): Tartak, a deity of the Avvites. Origin: of foreign derivation; KJV: Tartak.

H8663 תְּשֻׁאָה (tᵉshuʼâh, tesh-oo-aw'): a crashing or loud clamor. Origin: from H7722 (שׁוֹא); KJV: crying, noise, shouting, stir.

H8664 תִּשְׁבִּי (Tishbîy, tish-bee'): a Tishbite or inhabitant of Tishbeh (in Gilead). Origin: patrial from an unused name meaning recourse; KJV: Tishbite.

H8665 תַּשְׁבֵּץ (tashbêts, tash-bates'): checkered stuff (as reticulated). Origin: from H7660 (שָׁבַץ); KJV: broidered.

H8666 תְּשׁוּבָה (tᵉshûwbâh, tesh-oo-baw'): a recurrence (of time or place); a reply (as returned). Origin: or תְּשֻׁבָה; from H7725 (שׁוּב); KJV: answer, be expired, return.

H8667 תְּשׂוּמֶת (tᵉsûwmeth, tes-oo-meth'): a deposit, i.e. pledging. Origin: from H7760 (שׂוּם); KJV: [phrase] fellowship.

H8668 תְּשׁוּעָה (tᵉshûwʻâh, tesh-oo-aw'): rescue (literal or figurative, persons, national or spiritual). Origin: or תְּשֻׁעָה; from H7768 (שָׁוַע) in the sense of H3467 (יָשַׁע); KJV: deliverance, help, safety, salvation, victory.

H8669 תְּשׁוּקָה (tᵉshûwqâh, tesh-oo-kaw'): a longing. Origin: from H7783 (שׁוּק) in the original sense of stretching out after; KJV: desire.

H8670 תְּשׁוּרָה (tᵉshûwrâh, tesh-oo-raw'): a gift. Origin: from H7788 (שׁוּר) in the sense of arrival; KJV: present.

H8671 תְּשִׁיעִי (tᵉshîyʻîy, tesh-ee-ee'): ninth. Origin: ordinal from H8672 (תֵּשַׁע); KJV: ninth.

title: Strong's Hebrew Dictionary, H8672 to H8674
source: James Strong, A Concise Dictionary of the Words in the Hebrew Bible (1894), public domain; JSON edition by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA). Each entry: Strong number, Hebrew word, Latin reading, meaning, origin, how the KJV renders it.
body:
H8672 תֵּשַׁע (têshaʻ, tay'-shah): nine or (ordinal) ninth. Origin: or (masculine) תִּשְׁעָה; perhaps from H8159 (שָׁעָה) through the idea of a turn to the next or full number ten; KJV: nine ([phrase] -teen, [phrase] -teenth, -th).

H8673 תִּשְׁעִים (tishʻîym, tish-eem'): ninety. Origin: multiple from H8672 (תֵּשַׁע); KJV: ninety.

H8674 תַּתְּנַי (Tattᵉnay, tat-ten-ah'-ee): Tattenai, a Persian. Origin: of foreign derivation; KJV: Tatnai.
